bluejetty:00089301:ios.description:
Barakat is an excellent grocery delivery app that provides fresh fruits, vegetables, healthy juices, salads, ice creams, juice pops, and more. It is a convenient, user-friendly online grocery store that brings the widest variety of fresh produce from the best sources worldwide. We ensure our products' freshness and premium quality with same-day or next-day delivery via hygienic and food-grade refrigerated vehicles.
Barakat is the one-stop online platform to shop for a vast range of products, including daily groceries, fish, chicken, meat, and organic products, at the best prices. So, get ready to enjoy hassle-free grocery shopping and contactless home delivery with just a click of a button.
Key Features Of the Barakat App:
1. Wide Range Of Products: Barakat products include fresh vegetables, regular & organic vegetables, cut & sanitized vegetables, fresh fruits, cut fruits & fruit platters and fruit baskets, fresh juices, single fruit juices, fresh blends, keto juices, immunity-boosting juice shots, ice-creams, fresh juice popsicles, salads & crudités, dairy & eggs, ready to eat foods, marinated meat, bakery and more.
2. Affordable Prices & Great Offers: You can buy them at low prices with great offers and rewards. Moreover, Barakat Rewards is a program launched to reward loyal Barakat customers, which offers flexibility to earn and spend FreshCoins and access to exclusive deals and freebies when you shop online or refer a friend to shop at Barakat.
3. Assured Quality: We source most of our fruits, vegetables, and other organic products directly from farmers. Furthermore, we ensure that fruits and vegetables are carefully picked, sorted, packed, and home-delivered to ensure they are fresh from the farm to your home daily. 
4. Industry-Level Packaging: You can easily explore our range of fresh milk, cream, yogurt, lassi, paneer, and more. When you buy milk online, there could get spoilt in transit. However, with our industry-level packaging and storing process, your dairy products taste and feel fresh when you open them.
5. Excellent Refund Policy: Barakat is committed to 100% customer satisfaction. If you are unsatisfied with the quality or freshness of the product, return the product at the time of delivery. As our products are perishable so at the time of delivery you can check the goods and if you are not satisfied with our goods you can return them at the same time.
6. Safe Payment Options: Do grocery shopping online on Barakat and pay safely using your VISA or MasterCard credit or debit card in AED.
7. Delivery Locations & Time: Items offered on our website & app are only available for delivery to addresses in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Al Ain & Ajman U.A.E. An estimated delivery time will be provided to you once your order is placed. Delivery times are estimates and commence from the date of shipping rather than the date of order.
About Barakat App:
Barakat started its journey in 1976 with the most humble beginnings in the trade of fresh vegetables and fruits. We strive to be the most trusted source of healthy food in the UAE, with decades of experience sustaining the vibrant international sourcing network for fruits and vegetables of the highest quality standards from the best farms worldwide.
Barakat is the trusted supplier of fresh produce to leading supermarket chains, major airline catering companies, prominent families and other premium entities. Moreover, we value our longstanding and excellent relations with most hospitality and retail sector partners in the UAE. Barakat has ensured that the varied needs of each customer are consistently met with an extensive network of suppliers from around the world.
Reach Out To Us:
Our customer support team is always ready to help you out. So, feel free to contact us anytime at our mail id info@barakatfresh.ae or call us at +800 2272 528.
Download the Barakat app for a seamless and delightful online grocery shopping experience.

bluejetty:00065192:ios.name: Park State Bank
bluejetty:00065192:ios.summary: The Park State Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can sta
bluejetty:00065192:ios.description:
The Park State Bank App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Park State Bank customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Park State Bank App, you must be enrolled as a Park State Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00022639:ios.description:
Prospect Equities® Mobile Real Estate brings the most accurate and up-to-date real estate information right to your phone! With Prospect Equities® Mobile Real Estate, you have access to all homes for sale and rent, including MLS listings and our Private Inventory throughout Northern Illinois, New York City, South Florida, West & Central Florida, and the Phoenix Metro, including some International Properties.
Use Prospect Equities Mobile Real Estate anytime, anywhere to pull up homes for sale or rent around you using your current location, or find homes based on address, city or zip code using our smart search. Prospect Equities Mobile Real Estate will show you all the details you want to know about a property, including price, square footage, estimated mortgage, taxes, features, descriptions, pictures, maps and more! Save your favorite homes to view later. You can also text or email homes to your family and friends.
Some exciting app features include:
- A high-end search engine
- Gorgeous, high-resolution photographs
- Access to our Private Inventory
- For Sale or For Rent Search Options
- Geo Location to search properties nearest you
- Photo Slideshow of Listings
- Clear and easy to read listing details
- Pinpoint listings on map
- Mortgage Calculator
- Instant Directions to Listings
- Ability to share listings
- View Open Houses in your area
- Recommend Listings Pushed to your phone
- Data Driven Listing Matches
- New to Market Properties
- Price Reduction Listings
- Direct access to your Prospect Equities Agent
Prospect Equities Real Estate specializes in the following cities and neighborhoods:
Chicago, Lincoln Park, Lakeview, Gold Coast, Streeterville, South Loop, West Loop, River North, Oak Brook, Hinsdale, Barrington, Glenview, Naperville, Orland Park, New York City, Brooklyn, Bronx, Queens, Long Island, Westchester, Scottsdale, Phoenix, Paradise Valley, Glendale, Chandler, San Tan, Mesa, Biltmore, Miami, Coral Gables, Miami Beach, Edgewater, Fort Lauderdale, Bal Harbour, Brickell, Fisher Island, Tampa, St Petersburg, Clearwater, Harbor Island, Orlando.
If you have questions or want a tour of the home for sale, press the “Contact” feature to call or email a Prospect Equities Mobile Real Estate representative who can assist you.

bluejetty:00068085:ios.name: GetWardrobe Outfit Planner
bluejetty:00068085:ios.summary:
Your AI-powered wardrobe app — closet organizer and outfit planner trusted by 3 million users since 2013.
Plan what to wear, create stunning outfit collages, organize your closet digitally, and get AI-generated outfit ideas from your own c
bluejetty:00068085:ios.description:
Your AI-powered wardrobe app — closet organizer and outfit planner trusted by 3 million users since 2013.
Plan what to wear, create stunning outfit collages, organize your closet digitally, and get AI-generated outfit ideas from your own clothes. Synced across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Web.
GetWardrobe turns your phone into a smart digital closet. Add your clothes, and AI automatically detects the category, color, and suggests a name — so cataloguing takes seconds, not minutes. Whether you're building a capsule wardrobe, packing for a trip, or deciding what to wear tomorrow, GetWardrobe has you covered.
FREE FOREVER — NO TIME LIMITS
Your free closet includes everything you need:
– Up to 100 items (clothes and outfits) with no expiration
– AI BACKGROUND REMOVAL: Photograph any item and the AI removes the background automatically (advanced precision available with Premium)
– AI STUDIO: Generate outfits one by one from your wardrobe — free and unlimited
– AI OUTFIT GENERATOR (Starter): Get 10 AI-curated outfits per run, filtered by weather, occasion, and mood — unlimited free runs
– STORE IMPORT: Add items from online stores with brand, price, and product link saved automatically
– OUTFIT EDITOR: Drag, layer, and resize clothes on a canvas to create magazine-style collages
– WARDROBE ORGANIZER: Sort by category, brand, color, season, weather, tags, and more
– OUTFIT CALENDAR with local weather — plan what to wear for the week ahead
– STYLE STATISTICS: See what you wear most, what's sitting unused, and your wardrobe's estimated value
– EXPLORE COMBINATIONS: Swipe through item pairings and save the ones you love
– CLOUD SYNC across all your devices
– SIZES NOTEBOOK: Record how each brand fits you for smarter shopping
– CAPSULE WARDROBES: Build focused capsules for work, travel, seasons, or any goal
– ADVANCED SEARCH: AND/OR filters to find exactly the right piece
– WEATHER FORECAST: Daily forecasts with outfit & clothing suggestions based on conditions
– DARK MODE: Full dark theme across the entire app
– SHARE: Publish your OOTD lookbook to social media or the GetWardrobe community
AI CREDITS
Pay-as-you-go AI features — no subscription needed:
– AI OUTFIT GENERATOR (Standard & Pro): Generate 20–30 outfits per run with the most advanced AI models
– VIRTUAL TRY-ON: See how outfits look on you before getting dressed — powered by AI
– AI IMAGE ENHANCER: Turn phone photos into professional wardrobe shots automatically
GETWARDROBE PREMIUM
Unlock your full closet potential:
– UNLIMITED WARDROBE: Add every item you own with no limits
– FAMILY WARDROBE: Organize and create outfits for family members from a single account
– PACKING LISTS: Build smart packing lists sorted by trip purpose, destination weather, and weight
– STYLIST ACCESS: Give a professional stylist read or edit access to your closet
– ADVANCED STATS: Cost-per-wear, most-used combinations, wardrobe value, and utilization insights
– BULK EDITING: Update multiple items or outfits at once
– ARCHIVE: Store off-season or retired items without deleting them
WHY GETWARDROBE?
– On the App Store since 2013 — continuously updated
– 3M+ users across 39 countries
– Works offline and syncs when you're back online
– Your data stays private — your wardrobe belongs to you
– Cross-platform: iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Web
FOR STYLISTS: Manage multiple clients with a professional dashboard — create accounts, send branded invitations, and share recommendations. Your subscription unlocks Premium for all your clients.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
GetWardrobe Premium is available as a monthly or annual subscription. Subscription renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings.
Privacy Policy: https://getwardrobe.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://getwardrobe.com/terms-of-service
Need help? support@getwardrobe.com

bluejetty:00036328:ios.description:
Buy and sell literally anything in Ethiopia with Jiji! 
Whether you’re looking for affordable buys or make money selling, simply download the Jiji App to get started!
New to Jiji? Sign up now and discover an exciting world of easy online deals! 
MEET YOUR NEEDS 
Millions of ads in 16 product categories – whatever you need is definitely available on Jiji!
Hundreds of thousands of sellers are online to offer their products and help you with the selection!
Pay on delivery – discuss with the seller delivery options and pay only after inspecting the product. If you’re unhappy with what you received, just say “no”!
SELL WITH EASE
Post ads in a few clicks and convert your old stuff into cash!
Start your own business – all you need to do is register. No extra actions, clients are waiting for you to offer something!
Give your business a boost – use Premium Services to promote your products and reach 100x more interested customers all over the country! 
COMMUNICATE
Use Jiji Chat to communicate and discuss all product details or delivery options conveniently; 
Leave, check, and discuss feedback about the sellers so that all are aware of their reliability.
AND THERE’S MORE!
Get access to a variety of job openings to find your preferred job;
Order diverse services from people around Ethiopia to close any task effortlessly! 
Ready to give us a try? Download the Jiji app in one click and enjoy easy deals with Jiji!

bluejetty:00064148:ios.description:

Play North Sky Games’ brand new Spite & Malice game, also known as Skip-Bo and Cat and Mouse. Play all the cards from your payoff piles before your opponent and win the match! bluejetty:00023418:ios.name: Kid-E-Cats: Building Car Games
bluejetty:00023418:ios.summary: Together with Kid-E-Cats and other characters of the famous animated series we’ll build a real house for a family of cats. All your building skills will definitely come in handy for us. A great range of building vehicles and fantastic ideas
bluejetty:00023418:ios.description:
Together with Kid-E-Cats and other characters of the famous animated series we’ll build a real house for a family of cats. All your building skills will definitely come in handy for us. A great range of building vehicles and fantastic ideas!:)
Educational games with kittens and vehicles for toddlers train memory, fine motor skills and communication skills.
Let's help your favorite heroes build their own home! In the game we will go through all the stages of construction with both adult cats and kitty cats. Everyone will get a task that fits the skills!
To build the House for Kid-E-Cats we need construction vehicles: bulldozer, crane, truck and others!
Let's dive into the process of building a house! Miu-miu-miu!
Together with Kid-E-Cats we’ll assemble cars out of puzzles, refuel the vehicles and rush to the race!
Each level of the game has its own puzzles and its own car, its own races and tasks for getting more and more resources.
The house will grow from the foundation to the roof really fast provided we:
-clear a site to build a house
-drive the piles
-pour the concrete foundation
-lay pipes
-install a fireplace, a chimney and a brick house foundation
-put the roof on
-install and paint the windows
-plant trees and bushes
-and also…build a large playground for Kid-E-Cats!
Assembling puzzles, swiping while washing and tapping while playing perfectly develop fine motor skills and kids’ attention.
Kid-E-Cats are now known not only for casting in the animated series but also for featuring as nice helpers in the educational children's game!
Cool construction equipment which helps to recreate almost realistic building construction and action-packed mini-games make everyone get involved into carefree playing!
Boys and girls, humans and cats - we’ll build a House for Kid-E-Cats!

bluejetty:00061282:ios.description:
Harvest helps teams thrive with simple time tracking, real-time insights, long-term business intelligence, and tools to help you get paid faster. 
Easily track time, log expenses, and manage invoices on-the go with Harvest for iPhone. Start a timer when you’re visiting a client, or stop the one you left running at the office. The expense tracker lets you easily snap receipt photos as you enter expenses, and keeps all your records organized. Send professional invoices to your clients and check their payment status, wherever you are. And if you’re part of a team, you can easily access reports to understand how time is being spent and stay in sync.
SIMPLE TIME TRACKING & TIMESHEETS
 - Start and stop project and task timers from anywhere with a quick tap
 - Use Quick Time Entry to add common time values and save time
 - Save commonly used time entries to the home screen to start timers even faster
 - Mark hours as billable or non-billable
 - View and edit previous time entries
 - Track time online or offline
ACCESS KEY INFORMATION AND KEEP TABS ON TEAM STATUS
 - View a summary of your time report to understand where your time is going
 - View how your team’s time breaks down by project and task to stay in sync
 - Review detailed task notes for better project tracking
CAPTURE RECEIPTS AND LOG EXPENSES, CONVENIENTLY
 - Enter expenses quickly and easily on the go
 - Take receipts photos right from the app
 - Track mileage and more for reimbursement
 - Submit expenses for client projects
MANAGE INVOICES AND PAYMENTS
 - Send professional invoices and reminders
 - Record and update payments
 - Easily review past invoices

bluejetty:00073252:ios.name: Authentication App - MFA, tOTP
bluejetty:00073252:ios.summary: Protect your online accounts with the Authenticator App, a fast, secure, and privacy-focused two-factor authentication (2FA) app for iPhone and iPad. This app generates one-time verification codes (TOTP) for all your favorite services, help
bluejetty:00073252:ios.description:
Protect your online accounts with the Authenticator App, a fast, secure, and privacy-focused two-factor authentication (2FA) app for iPhone and iPad. This app generates one-time verification codes (TOTP) for all your favorite services, helping safeguard your accounts against unauthorized access.
Whether you are switching from Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, or another authenticator app, importing and managing your accounts is quick and effortless.
Setting up your accounts takes only seconds. Simply scan a QR code, import from a photo, or enter your account details manually. No account creation or sign-up is required.
Built with privacy in mind, your authentication codes remain under your control. With optional iCloud Keychain backup and sync, you can securely restore your accounts when upgrading to a new iPhone or replacing a lost device.
Why choose the Authenticator App?
- Fast QR code scanning
- Import codes from photos or add them manually
- Compatible with all standard TOTP and HOTP authentication services
- Face ID protection for secure access
- App passcode lock for additional security
- Secure iCloud Keychain backup and sync across your Apple devices
- Works offline after setup
- No intrusive advertisements
- We do not collect or sell your personal data
- Clean, modern, and easy-to-use interface
Compatible with thousands of services
The Authenticator App works with virtually every service that supports two-factor authentication (2FA), including email providers, social media platforms, cloud storage, financial services, developer platforms, cryptocurrency exchanges, gaming accounts, and more.
As long as a service supports standard QR-code based authentication, it will work with the Authenticator App.
Download the app today and protect your digital life with secure two-factor authentication.
Subscription Information
The Authenticator App is free to download, with optional premium features available through auto-renewing subscriptions.
- Monthly: $9.99/month
- Yearly: $39.99/year
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.
Privacy Policy & Terms
Privacy Policy: https://benabid.me/privacy
Terms of Service: https://benabid.me/terms
Support
Do you have questions or feedback? 
Email us at: contact@benabid.me
Thank you for choosing the Authenticator App!

bluejetty:00070034:ios.description:
Seeing AI is a free app that narrates the world around you. Designed with and for the blind and low vision community, this ongoing research project harnesses the power of AI to open up the visual world by describing nearby people, text and objects. 
Seeing AI provides tools to assist with a variety of daily tasks: 
• Read - Hear text as soon as it appears in front of the camera. Document alignment provides audio cues to capture a printed page and recognize the text along with its original formatting. Ask Seeing AI about the contents to easily find the information you need.
• Describe - Take photos to hear a rich description. Ask questions to focus on the information you care about. Explore photos by moving your finger over the screen to hear the location of different objects.
• Products - Scan barcodes and Accessible QR codes using audio beeps to guide you; hear the product name and package information when available.
• People - Save photos of friends and coworkers so you can recognize them later. Get an estimate of their age, gender, and expression.
• Currency - Recognize currency notes. 
• Find My Things - Teach Seeing AI to recognize your personal objects and follow the audio cues to find them later. 
• World - An Audio Augmented Reality experience to explore an unfamiliar environment, including hearing objects announced around you with Spatial Audio (requires a device with a LiDAR, and iOS 14+). 
• Colors - Identify colors.
• Light - Hear an audible tone corresponding to the brightness of your surroundings.
• Photos and Videos in other apps - Just tap “Share” and “Recognize with Seeing AI” to describe media from Mail, Photos, WhatsApp, and more. 
• Browse Photos - Hear descriptions of photos and videos saved on your device.
Seeing AI continues to evolve as we hear from the community, and AI research advances.
Visit http://SeeingAI.com for more details.
Questions, feedback or feature requests? Email us at SeeingAI@Microsoft.com.

Start your fascina
bluejetty:00064110:ios.description:
Solar Walk Ads+ is an amazing 3D model of our Solar system bringing the universe to the palm of your hand and allowing you to interact with planets, satellites, moons, comets and other space objects anytime and anywhere.
Start your fascinating journey through the realms of space and learn more about the universe we live in.
*** Over 6 million users!***
*** National Parenting Publications Awards (NAPPA) - GOLD winner in the Educational Tools for Parents and Children category! *** 
*** A Parents’ Choice Gold Award Winner *** 
“Simply amazing.” - Macworld
“Solar Walk serves up a visually impressive 3D model of our solar system. Set against a haunting, atmospheric soundscape, the app shows planets and satellites in their correct positions, and offers mini movies, facts and other related tidbits.” - TNW
“This jaw-dropping app provides a wholly interactive 3D model of our solar system, one that’s had me hooked for days. It’s the kind of thing you can imagine a science teacher using in the classroom of the future — except that we don’t have to wait.” - CNet
“Zoom from Mercury to Pluto (which makes the cut in this app), passing each planet’s moons along the way. Because Solar Walk knows what time it is, the planets are in proper orientation to the Sun: Earth is dark where it is currently night and gradually lightens to daytime on the other side.” - NY Times
"It's great for showing my students the relative positions of the planets in the solar system, the satellites orbiting the Earth and our place in the galaxy. Awesome with a smartboard as well." - by jbrown61
Solar Walk Ads+ enables you to:
► Observe the 3D model of our Solar system with all its objects in real time and in a proper orientation. Turn into an astronomer and explore planets, moons, satellites, asteroids, dwarf planets, comets, stars and other celestial bodies. Enjoy gorgeous graphics and visuals while navigating through the solar system.
► Make virtual flights from one space object to another.
► Travel in time and see what the universe and our Solar system looked like at a certain period.
► Find an exciting view of the Milky Way Galaxy.
► Watch a collection of educational solar system movies to learn about space-related topics including Earth's moon phases, Earth's cycles, tidal phenomena, and zodiacal constellations.
► Enjoy 3D planetarium with the help of special glasses and activating the anaglyph mode.
► Share interesting screenshots of the app with your friends.
► Choose the view mode comfortable for you (orrery/true-to-scale).
The app contains In-App Purchases. In-App Purchases won't remove ads from the application.
Solar Walk Ads+ is a great educational tool appropriate for both adults and children. The amount of information users can learn about the planets, moons, satellites and other celestial bodies is impressive. All information is age-appropriate and detailed. Animated video clips will make learning about our Solar system even more engaging.
Start exploring the universe with Solar Walk Ads+!

bluejetty:00017244:ios.description:
Have you taken an L recently? You don't have to answer that because the app will use your facial expressions to determine if you took an L.
"L" stands for Loss. Originally used to describe one's disposition of engaging in an activity that he/she does not particularly like.
This is a game where you play with friends to see who can take the least amount of Ls.
A statement is read, then the app uses facial expressions to determine if the user has done it before.
So, next time you take a massive L, breathe in a deep breath, let that s*** wash over you and learn to laugh about it. Recognize the humor.
Inspired by popular youtubers doing You Laugh You Lose Challenge, Would you rather, truth or dare, smash or pass, try not to laugh, 1000 Degree Knife, or Bottle Flip challenge. All these party apps were similar and fun, but rather than ask the user to pick yes or no, we add a twist and use facial expressions to answer for you.
You have options to generate your own statements, or play with statements submitted by users. 1 or 2 players available.
Do us a favor and Take this L.
*Works with different phone language settings*

This is a game where you play with friends to see who can take the least amount of Ls.

A statement is read, then the app uses facial expressions to determine if the user has done it before.

So, next time you take a massive L, breathe in a deep breath, let that s*** wash over you and learn to laugh about it. Recognize the humor.

Inspired by popular youtubers doing You Laugh You Lose Challenge, Would you rather,  truth or dare, smash or pass, try not to laugh, 1000 Degree Knife, or Bottle Flip challenge. All these party apps were similar and fun, but rather than ask the user to pick yes or no, we add a twist and use facial expressions to answer for you.

You have options to generate your own statements, or play with statements submitted by users. 1 or 2 players available.

Do us a favor and Take this L.

*Works with different phone language settings*

Jain Panchang is a complete Panchang and calendar app for the Jain community, covering Tithi, Choghadiya, Nakshatra, and Muhurat timings alongside the full Jain festival calendar - with accurate Panchang 2026 and Panchang 2027 dates as each year begins.
Check today's Tithi, Choghadiya, Rahu Kalam, and Abhijit Muhurat for your city, track Paryushan Parv and Samvatsari Mahaparv, and follow Tithi as observed by your Sampraday.

- My Events: personal dates with Tithi-based yearly reminders
- Calendar Sync: add Panchang reminders to your device calendar
- Home screen widgets for Panchang, timings, and Choghadiya
- Apple Watch app for Panchang and Choghadiya at a glance (Premium)
- 100 Years of Panchang: browse any month or year, not just the current one
- English, Hindi, and Gujarati support

bluejetty:00062678:ios.summary:
Check out this video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3xePnu3MsBQ
IMPORTANT NOTICE: 
1. This app emulates G1000 MFD functionalities only. It does not include PFD functionalities. To obtain PFD functionalities, download the PFD app from App
bluejetty:00062678:ios.description:
Check out this video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3xePnu3MsBQ
IMPORTANT NOTICE: 
1. This app emulates G1000 MFD functionalities only. It does not include PFD functionalities. To obtain PFD functionalities, download the PFD app from AppStore which can co-operate with this app(MFD) via wifi connection.
Download address of PFD app: http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/id501990787?mt=8
2. This app is for practice only. The navigation database included in this app may be outdated and very possible to be different from what it is in real life.
3. Due to huge memory consumption, it's highly recommended that you install this app on an iPad which has at least 1G memory on board. Thus, install this app on iPad 1, iPad 2 or iPad mini is not recommended. Running this app on iPad Air or newer devices will get you a much better performance.
Disclaimer: 
-Simionic and the seller are not affiliated with Garmin, 
-The app is not provided, approved, endorsed, or otherwise supported by Garmin. 
This is an app which simulates the Multi Function Display(MFD) of the Garmin G1000 used on Cessna 182T, 172S, 172R, 206H and Beechcraft Baron G58. It can also be configured to adapt piston, turboprop and jet engines. Most of the functionalities are implemented just as they are in the real life. It can be used by aviation enthusiasts as well as pilots to perform either an IFR training or just to familiarize the operations of G1000 MFD. This app is capable to connect to another app which simulates the G1000 PFD via wifi connection through which you can have a complete set of G1000 and make them work with FSX, Prepar3D , X-Plane or InfiniteFlight to get the best experience.
G1000 is a highly integrated system, it is very powerful and also very complicated. It is recommended that you have a real G1000 user guide from Garmin. 
Details:
1. Global navigation database and topo data
2. Engine status simulation
3. Functional "Map Setup"
4. All pages including AUX pages are implemented
5. Terminal procedures are included
6. User waypoint creating/editing
7. User defined holding patterns
8. Flight plans storing/editing
9. Checklists for Cessna 182T, 172S, 172R and 206H are included
10. PFD connection via wifi

● OVERCOME obstacles like Brain Freezes and jump ahead using boosters like Brain Storms! 
● IMMERSE yourself in the world of the film through stunning 3D animation and gameplay featuring voice actors from the film!

bluejetty:00093138:ios.description:
Gesta Condomínios e Contabilidade
Tranquilidade, Eficiência e Eficácia é o que todos procuram, mas poucas empresas conseguem entregar com qualidade os serviços a que se propõem, conheça nossos serviços e entenda porque somos a melhor solução para atender às suas necessidades e expectativas.
Tanto pelo site da Gesta quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Os recursos disponíveis vão desde a simples gestão dos boletos em aberto quanto à abertura de portas do prédio usando as integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo pushs para questões mais importantes, acesso online e em tempo real.
Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para gesta@winker.com.br.

bluejetty:00037326:ios.name: Greenwood - Mobile Banking
bluejetty:00037326:ios.summary:
Greenwood is the new financial home for the Black and Latino communities. Become one of the 500,000+ who have joined the movement. When you open an account through Greenwood, you can save money, help the community, and get paid early. 
Gre
bluejetty:00037326:ios.description:
Greenwood is the new financial home for the Black and Latino communities. Become one of the 500,000+ who have joined the movement. When you open an account through Greenwood, you can save money, help the community, and get paid early. 
Greenwood is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by Coastal Community Bank, Member FDIC. Deposits are insured up to $250,000 per depositor. FDIC insurance only covers the failure of an FDIC-insured bank. FDIC insurance is available through pass-through insurance at Coastal Community Bank, Member FDIC, if certain conditions have been met. The Greenwood Debit Mastercard® is issued by Coastal Community Bank pursuant to a license by Mastercard International.
DIGITAL SAVINGS AND SPENDING ACCOUNTS
Whether you’re putting money aside to build towards your goals or seeking a spending account that makes your money go further, Greenwood has an account to support you. Open a savings account today with no minimum or monthly fees and earn 4.15% APY. Our spending account includes a Mastercard-branded debit card with a wealth of benefits including, zero liability, identity theft protection, and global emergency services.
INVEST IN YOURSELF. NOT FEES.
No overdraft - no fees
No ATM surcharge fees at participating locations
No minimum balance fees
No peer-to-peer transfer fees
JOIN US. PAY IT FORWARD.
When you open an account through Greenwood, you save money and help the community. Recirculating wealth in our communities is at core of why we exist.
Feed 5 meals to a family through Goodr when you create an account. Give to UNCF and NAACP through spare change round-ups. 
CONTACTLESS SERVICES USING APPLE PAY AND MOBILE DIRECT DEPOSIT FOR QUICK AND SECURE PAYMENTS.
Pay at participating grocery, retail and other stores  with your mobile device
Complete purchases online without entering your card number
Get cash back with qualifying debit transactions. Maintain peace of mind with Mastercard's zero liability policy for unauthorized purchases. Deposit checks into your spending or savings account 24/7 right from your mobile device, no branch or ATM visits required.
FEE-FREE ATM WITHDRAWALS WORLDWIDE
Withdrawals at Allpoint, Moneypass, Wells Fargo and PNC ATMs are surcharge free.
GET PAID EARLY
With direct deposit, you may receive your payroll and other ACH deposits as soon as they’re available – often as much as two days before your actual pay date.
EARLY DIRECT DEPOSIT
Direct Deposit early availability depends on timing of payor’s payment instructions and fraud prevention restrictions may apply. As such, the availability or timing of early direct deposit may vary from pay period to pay period.
MASTERCARD ZERO LIABILITY POLICY
Mastercard's Zero Liability Policy covers U.S.-issued cards and does not apply to certain commercial card transactions or any transactions not processed by Mastercard. You must notify your financial institution immediately of any unauthorized use. For specific restrictions, limitations and other details, please consult your issuer.
APY
The Annual Percentage Yield (APY) for savings accounts through Greenwood is variable and is subject to change at any time. The disclosed APY is effective as of May 22, 2023. An account must have $0.01 in savings to earn interest. The national average is 0.40% APY as of May 15, 2023. Obtained from FDIC.

bluejetty:00083867:ios.description:
Connect your camera with your phone and bring your photography skills to a new level. This app is the reason why gps & wifi suddenly makes sense on your camera. 
Features:
- View all pictures on the camera in a nice grid.
- Quick loading of jpg and raw files (CR2 and NEF).
- Directly share pictures from camera to other apps (like Whatsapp, Instagram, Facebook)
- Download complete files from camera to files app
- Remote capture
- Connect your camera to the hotspot of your phone if no wifi is available
- see protected files
- Bulb capture
- Focus bracketing
- Use liveview to control all settings of your camera
- Use usb or wifi connection 
Features of paid version:
Lite
- show Exif data (including gps data)
- download of singles files (also Raw)
- bulk download, bulk delete, bulk share
- filter current view (raw, jpeg, videos, protected files)
Pro
- Liveview with camera control
- Change settings of the camera (shutter speed, aperture, exposure compensation, iso, whitebalance, picture style, drivemode, metering, image format)

bluejetty:00014693:ios.summary:

This app allows users to manage their Lightspeed product catalog, sell to customers, and handle product inventory from the conv
bluejetty:00014693:ios.description:
Lightspeed Scanner is the mobile companion app for the Lightspeed Retail (X-Series) Point-of-Sale (POS) system.
This app allows users to manage their Lightspeed product catalog, sell to customers, and handle product inventory from the convenience of a mobile phone. Lightspeed Scanner turns your device's camera into a powerful barcode reader, making it fast and easy to identify and count products from your Retail catalog.
Key features of Lightspeed Scanner:
• Add or edit products: Record Name, Description, Price, SKU Codes, Locations, and Product Images directly to your Lightspeed Retail catalog.
• Sell from anywhere: Turn your phone into a mobile register. Accept payment via Tap to Pay for iPhone (Lightspeed Payments users only), sell On Account, or Park sales to complete them on any in-store register.
• View product information: Search your product catalog and view details like price, stock levels, descriptions, and images.
• Inventory management: Perform or schedule full and partial inventory counts. Create or add to supplier purchase orders and outlet transfer orders. You can also receive stock, fulfill transfers, and record inventory adjustments. For additional accuracy, inventory and orders counted on the app must be completed on the Lightspeed Retail POS system, giving managers ultimate control of inventory movements.
Key use cases for Lightspeed Scanner:
• Mobile clienteling: Quick access to the catalog makes this a great tool for sales associates assisting customers on the shop floor. Staff can check pricing and availability without leaving the customer's side.
• Mobile selling: Enable stores to sell from anywhere, such as pop-up events or on the shop floor. Lightspeed Scanner allows you to offer dynamic, personalized shopping experiences.
• Mobile catalog management: Edit your Lightspeed product catalog from anywhere to ensure details are always up to date. Changes made in the app sync directly with ecommerce systems connected to Lightspeed Retail.
• Mobile order management: Picking and packing orders is simple on Lightspeed Scanner. With the app installed on your phone, you can pick orders without carrying additional hardware.
• Finding inventory quickly: Check inventory levels across multiple outlets. Product locations are visible and editable within the app, allowing staff to quickly navigate to where products are stored.
• Recording needs: Use the List building function to easily record products that need to be re-stocked, re-labelled, marked as damaged, or transferred to another outlet.
Hardware and Syncing:
• The app syncs directly with your POS system via WiFi or mobile network, ensuring all actions are visible instantly on the Lightspeed Retail system.
• Users of Lightspeed Retail who prefer infrared barcode readers over the built-in camera scanner can connect Socket barcode readers directly to Lightspeed Scanner.
Submit feedback or feature requests:
We’re always improving Lightspeed Scanner to help users perform their daily tasks more efficiently. Submit feedback anytime by navigating to the Account page, then selecting ‘Send us your feedback’.
Visit the Lightspeed Retail (X-Series) help centre for guided assistance on using Lightspeed Scanner.

bluejetty:00078518:ios.description:
Start learning Ukrainian with words and phrases you can read, listen to and practice at your own pace. English meanings and pronunciation guides help you explore the language.
CHOOSE WHAT TO LEARN
Explore 252 lessons across 26 chapters, including the alphabet, greetings, numbers, food, family, home, work, travel, transport, nature and more.
Prefer a focused route? Choose from five mini courses: Starter Pack, Travel Basics, Food & Restaurant, Family & Home, and Health & Emergency. Each brings related lessons together around a useful topic.
LISTEN AND REVIEW
Choose between the Polina and Maksym voice options for available recordings. Adjust playback speed and replay words or phrases as you study. Lesson text and available bundled recordings can be used offline after installation. Purchases, ads and sending support messages require an internet connection.
PRACTICE WHAT YOU LEARN
Review with flashcards, answer multiple-choice and true-or-false questions, match words with their meanings, and type answers in writing exercises. Revisit words that need more practice and check your exercise results.
MAKE STUDYING PERSONAL
Save favorite words and phrases for quick review. Follow your learning progress, record daily check-ins and set study reminders with notification permission. Choose a theme and learning appearance that suits you.
KEEP A COPY OF YOUR PROGRESS

bluejetty:00074106:ios.description:

- Control volume

- Mute and unmute
- Adjust equalizer settings

- Customize manual programs with Reduce Noise, Enhance Conversation, Focus Microphone, and Sound Contrast IQ controls

bluejetty:00069794:ios.description:
Find your new home with Germany's No. 1 real estate app.
Whether you're renting your first apartment, looking for a shared flat (WG), buying a family home or investing in real estate, ImmoScout24 helps you find the right home in Germany.
Why ImmoScout24?
• Germany's largest selection of property listings
• Germany's largest community of home seekers
• Highest customer satisfaction*
• Official SCHUFA Credit Check in the app
• AI-powered home search & smart filters
• Discover apartments before everyone else
Download the app now to rent, buy, sell or list apartments, houses and commercial property.
_______
Search
Find apartments, houses, shared flats (WG), commercial property and land using powerful filters for location, price, size, rooms, balcony, terrace, fitted kitchen, energy efficiency and year of construction.
Draw your preferred search area directly on the map and discover homes exactly where you want to live.
Smart AI filters with image recognition
Go beyond traditional filters. AI analyses listing photos, property details and location to find homes that match your lifestyle. Looking for a lake-view apartment? A house with an open-plan kitchen or floor-to-ceiling windows? A shared flat with parquet flooring? We'll help you find it.
AI real estate expert – "HeyImmo"
HeyImmo answers your questions about renting, buying and finding property in Germany—24/7. Is the asking price fair? Are there daycare centres nearby? What renovations might be needed? HeyImmo helps you make informed decisions before viewing or applying.
Explore neighbourhoods with "Scout the Streets"
Open your camera and discover apartments, houses, shared flats and other properties around you. Explore streets and neighbourhoods in an interactive 3D view before you move.
Discover apartments earlier with the "Tenant Network"
Get ahead of other home seekers. Discover apartments before they're officially listed and access homes that are about to become available before they're publicly advertised.
Get more with SuchenPlus
Increase your visibility, unlock early access to selected listings and enjoy additional benefits while searching for your next home (paid feature).
Push notifications
Receive instant alerts for new apartments, houses, real estate and WG listings and apply in just a few taps.
Watchlist
Save your favourite apartments, houses and properties and compare them anytime.
Messages
Chat directly with landlords, real estate agents and property owners and stay informed with instant push notifications.
Official SCHUFA Credit Check
Request your official SCHUFA Credit Check directly in the app and add it to your application profile. 
_______
List, Rent Out & Sell
With ImmoScout24 you can easily list, rent out or sell your property.
List your property for free
Create a listing in just a few clicks and advertise your property free of charge for 14 days as a private advertiser.
Free property valuation
Receive a free property valuation and find the right price for your apartment, house, land or commercial property. Our Price Atlas compares local property prices and real estate values in your area.
Germany's largest real estate agent network
Get expert advice from experienced real estate professionals and sell or rent out your property at the best possible price.
_______
With more than 6.5 million listings, ImmoScout24 is Germany's largest real estate marketplace—ahead of immowelt, immonet, Kleinanzeigen and WG-Gesucht. For more than 25 years, millions of people have trusted ImmoScout24 every month to rent an apartment, buy a house, find real estate and successfully list their property in Germany.
Whether you're moving to Germany, looking for a WG, renting your first apartment or buying a house, ImmoScout24 helps you find your next home faster.
We'd love your feedback!
Email us at app-support@immobilienscout24.de or leave us a review here.
*Goldberger Marktanalytik, “Brand Study”, quantitative online survey, n=1,033, April 2026.

bluejetty:00016381:ios.description:
Adventure awaits!
In the magical world of Fantasy Island Sim live many tribes, each with their own quests, skills and secrets. The pirates for example like to explore the secrets of the world and collect treasures found in chests. Need to boost your economy? Trade goods and resources with the gnomes. One day the Dwarfs will build their castle, until then they will harvest ore and forge gold for you. The elves are legendary in solving daily quests by using their magic. The villagers love to farm and produce crops.
Explore the magical world of Fantasy Island Sim.
Expand your kingdom into an empire and discover cute tribes like the gnomes, pirates, elves, polars, dwarfs and villagers. Each tribe has unique buildings you can build, most of them are epic, some are even legendary. 
Gather resources and construct buildings.
Start with a medieval town and build up your economy by constructing production buildings and produce resources. You can harvest their goods and use these resources to construct new homes and shops. Slowly you will grow your town into a city.
What is your strategy?
In this city building simulation game you need to keep morale high in order to keep production up. But be aware, push your tribes too hard and they will leave your city.
Trade with your friends.
Use your skills to produce goods and trade resources with your friends! Play together and discover new tribes, unlock secret skills and find hidden treasures.
Enjoy this new city building simulation game together!
Features
Fantasy city building game
Unlock different tribes and grow your kingdom into an empire
Solve daily quests
Explore the world and expand your kingdom
Harvest ore and forge gold
Choose your own path: strategy or simulation?
Playable both offline and online
Fantasy Island Sim is free to download and free to play. However, you can purchase in-app items with real money. If you wish to disable this feature, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet’s settings.
Check out other cool games from Sparkling Society, the creators of Fantasy Island Sim!

bluejetty:00086451:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00086451:ios.description:
Teledipity is a personal growth platform that uses numerology to help you better understand yourself, your relationships, and the timing of your life.
Our software has an eerie ability to reach you at the right moment with the right message, delivering highly targeted advice, introspections, book recommendations, and wisdom from history's greatest philosophers.
We're here to boost your confidence, remind you of what matters, and help you stay open to life's opportunities. 
A DIFFERENT KIND OF APP
No social media scraping. No AI-generated insights. No cookie spying. Every reading is written by a person — and the only source of our magic is an algorithm that has been around for 2,300 years. Go figure.
You're the captain of your own ship. We're the compass.
ELEVEN YEARS AND COUNTING
Independent since 2014! No ads, no cookies, no data sold, ever. Just content people describe as honest, accurate, and "my go-to place."
Dive into your greatest timeline. Create a FREE account today.
The FREE Teledipity experience includes:
-Character Analysis Report: Seven sections and over 65 pages analyzing your personality traits, talents, life cycles, and areas of improvement.
-Serendipitous Messages in a Personalized FEED: Our 2,300-year-old algorithm knows where you are, what you're going through, and what kind of motivation, inspiration, or perspective you need at any given time.
-Yearly and Monthly Forecasts: The Pythagorean Sequence is not about prediction or fortune-telling. It is about the dominant influence and priorities of any given chapter of your life, and how it fits into the tapestry of your overall journey.
-Book Recommendations: Our software is not the be-all end-all. We find you the books you need the most at each specific chapter of your life.
-Objectives: We help you actively implement the information we deliver with guided objectives for each year.
-Personalized Monthly Podcasts: Every 1st of the month, you will get a 5-15 minute motivational podcast going deeper into the life lessons that await during the next month of your life. These audios include suggestions for further reading or longer explanations about the topic you should focus on to get the most out of your experiences.
Take your experience to the next level by purchasing a membership to Teledipity PREMIUM, where you will get:
-Unlimited Compatibility Reports: compare your personality with that of friends, family members, lovers or co-workers. Create as many as you want!
-Weekly Forecasts and PREMIUM updates: your PREMIUM membership will take Teledipity's presence in your life to the next level. Get a weekly forecast every Monday, and an additional serendipitous email every week (in other words - insights bi-weekly instead of bi-monthly).
-Unlimited Essays (audio reflections): challenges are audio introspections on topics such as building your dreams,, self-care routines, and similar self-improvement topics.
Teledipity PREMIUM is available in three auto-renewing subscription options:
Teledipity Premium Monthly for $11 per month
Teledipity Premium Quarterly for $25.49 every three months
Teledipity Premium Yearly for $69.99 per year
If you can’t get enough of our content, we offer an optional $127 add-on to the Teledipity subscription known as the FLOW Calendar, a week-by-week analysis of the next 12 months in your life with date-specific advice.
* Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. For more information, please visit our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
Terms of Service: https://www.teledipity.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.teledipity.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00078174:ios.description:
Falifi: Designed for Relationship Seekers
Falifi is the dating app designed for people who want to connect meaningfully. Whether you’re seeking love, friendship, or a meaningful connection, Falifi helps you find genuine connections in a fun and safe environment.
How We Help You Find Your Connection
Falifi is on a mission to change the way you meet people. With our unique features, we make it easier than ever to meet like-minded individuals for relationships and friendships, no matter what you’re looking for:
Quickly Learn Your Type:
Falifi’s smart matching algorithms connect you with the best people based on your interests, preferences, and values.
See Real Personalities:
Discover potential matches through detailed profiles, including prompts, photos, videos, and personal interests. It’s not just about looks — it’s about who you really are.
Easy Conversations:
Start meaningful conversations by liking or commenting on specific parts of someone’s profile. It’s all about getting the conversation started with ease.
More Than Just Dating:
Whether you're here for love, friendship, or genuine connections, Falifi offers a space for everyone. Find people who share your goals, interests, and values — and let the connection grow.
Video Profiles:
Express yourself better with short video profiles. Let potential matches see and hear you, making your profile more personal and engaging.
Safe & Secure:
Safety is a top priority at Falifi. With secure messaging, profile verification, and robust reporting tools, you can feel confident while meeting new people.
Community Events:
Participate in exclusive events, webinars, and meetups to connect with others in your area or virtually.
Matchmaking Made Easy:
Our advanced matching system ensures that you’re connected with people who meet your relationship preferences, whether you’re looking for friendship or a serious relationship.
Comprehensive Profiles:
Create a profile that reflects who you truly are. Detailed profiles help you make informed decisions when finding a match.
Local and Global Connections:
Whether you're looking for someone nearby or open to long-distance relationships, Falifi allows you to connect locally or globally.
Like, Match, Date, Love, Friendship:
Falifi is all about exploring your connections. Swipe, like, and match with people who interest you. Whether it's love, friendship, or a meaningful relationship, your journey starts here.
Premium Features:
While Falifi is free to use, you can unlock even more features like advanced search filters and unlimited likes with a premium subscription.
Subscription Info
Payment will be charged to your account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal through Account Settings after purchase.
Why Falifi?
Find your special someone, a new friend, or even just a fun date. Falifi is where genuine connections are made — for love, friendship, or anything in between. Join the diverse and supportive community today and start your journey towards meaningful relationships.
Find. Match. Chat. Date. Love. Friendship.
Support: support@falifi.com
Terms of Service: https://falifi.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://falifi.com/privacy

bluejetty:00018672:ios.description:
Healthify is trusted by over 40 million users globally to simplify their health journey. Whether your goal is weight loss, improved nutrition, or enhanced fitness, Healthify provides you with world class technology & services to support you make data driven decisions through every step of the way. With Healthify you can
- Track Calories with photo or voice
- Log Meals
- Get personalized AI Insights & actionables
- Track Water
- Track Sleep
- Track Weight
- Track Workouts & Activity
Healthify uses image based smart AI recognition technology to bring you the convenience of tracking calories and meals with just pictures. Healthify App is also empowered with an AI Nutrition Coach to take personalisation to a next level with insights and analysis.
KEY FEATURES
SNAP: HEALTHIFY’S IMAGE-BASED INSTANT CALORIE TRACKER
- Experience the world's most advanced image-based food recognition system.

bluejetty:00026784:ios.description:
My Diary provides a friendly, professional, and personalized diary-journal experience. With its beautiful and thoughtful design, it lets you enjoy every memorable moment.
WHAT IS MY DIARY?
My Diary is a free online diary with lock. You can use it to record daily journals, secret thoughts, journeys, mood trackers, and any private moments. It is a diary that supports adding photos, themes, diary background, mood, font effects, etc., making your private diary more vivid and safe. Committed to providing the most intimate diary-journal writing experience for users who want to keep a diary and care about their mental health.
With the My Diary app, you can:
Write diaries or record journeys anytime, anywhere
Write photo diaries. Add pictures or drawings to make your personal diary more vivid
Customize your journals with themes, moods, font effects, stickers
Use it as a mood-tracker and get mood analysis
Set a password to lock your diary and protect your memories
JOURNALING FOR MENTAL HEALTH
Journaling is a simple way to write down your thoughts and feelings to manage your mental health and control your emotions. Journaling has many benefits, including:
Clear fear and concerns
Manage anxiety and reduce stress
Expressing your emotions. Journaling is really a good mental health tracker and mood tracker
Learn from your experiences and make you happier
Gain control of your emotions etc
REASONS FOR CHOOSING THIS JOURNALING APP
1. Easy-to-use & Beautiful interface 
* It provides beautiful diary themes. Add enjoyment to every moment of daily journaling
* Night dark theme. Makes it more comfortable when you keep a journal at night
* Well-designed pages, let you start a journal or take notes easily
* Providing journaling guides, Follow it step by step to complete the first diary.
* Powerful rich text effect. It gives you the best experience whether you take journeys notes or write diaries.
2. Safe and Private
* My Diary, as a private diary app, protects your memories by setting an app passcode. You can turn on the diary lock to make your diary safe.
* We recommend that you set a security question to avoid forgetting your password and being unable to visit your journal.
3. Photo Diary, More Than Words 
* My Diary is a Photo diary. Add photos to make your private journals more memorable.
* Check all journal photos in the Media View Mode
* Add drawings to reflect your ideas and thoughts
4. Decorate Your Diary 
* Enjoy the Diary illustrated themes. Whether it’s a travel journal, health journal, girl diary, or mood tracker diary, there will always be a theme you like (Some of them are Premium)
* Choose backgrounds when writing journal entries, see how lovely private journals can be (Some of them are Premium)
* Writing about your feelings helps the brain overcome upsets, clear fears and leaves you happier
5. Mood Tracker 
* Some moods cannot be expressed in words, so you can choose mood diary symbols. Add your mood when you start writing diaries or take day notes
* Track mood in the mood calendar
* Check your mood trends in statistics
* Be your free metal health tracker
6. Categorize Your Daily Notes with Tags 
* Adding tags for your daily journals
* The suggested categories include Travel notes, work notes, love diary, baby diary, daily motivations, pregnancy diary, etc
* Easily check your entries by tags
In summary, It is really a good photo journaling app free for you, a lovely secret diary with lock and a great mood tracker & mental health tracker, which deserves to be installed.

bluejetty:00044814:ios.name: Sonar - Health & Performance
bluejetty:00044814:ios.summary: Your body is talking. Are you listening? Sonar unifies all of your wearables, lifestyle, and biomarker data to unlock personalized insights and detection once reserved for elite athletes and biohackers. Trusted by 250,000+ users across 170+
bluejetty:00044814:ios.description:
Your body is talking. Are you listening? Sonar unifies all of your wearables, lifestyle, and biomarker data to unlock personalized insights and detection once reserved for elite athletes and biohackers. Trusted by 250,000+ users across 170+ countries, Sonar helps you cut through the noise across sleep, recovery, stress, activity, and nutrition - so you can focus on what actually matters.
Sonar isn't just another health tracker. It merges the latest medical, sports and data science with AI engines that continuously surface subtle shifts and patterns across millions of data points, helping you know when to push, when to pause, and where to focus next.
FEATURES:
Personalized intelligence
Sonar AI is a personal health agent grounded in the data across your wearables, health apps, and connected devices. Ask questions, understand changes in your scores, and get answers that reflect your actual data - not generic advice. Sonar AI also remembers personal context you give it like training goals, travel, or new routines, and factors it into how it interprets your data over time.
Sync everything
Fragmented data means missed signals. Connect Apple Watch, Garmin, Oura, Fitbit, Strava, Withings, MyFitnessPal, Peloton and many more.
Daily scores and guidance
Recovery, Strain, Sleep, Stress, Energy, and Nutrition scores help you understand your day at a glance, with practical guidance to improve.
Correlations & comparisons
See how any two metrics relate over time. Plot exercise against sleep, alcohol against HRV, or stress against recovery to surface the patterns driving how you feel each day. Compare up to six metrics at once, or focus the view on a single category like activity, sleep, or recovery.
24/7 vitals monitoring
Track trends in HRV, resting heart rate, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, body temperature, and more, and get notified when values move outside your typical range.
Training analytics
All workouts in one place, with detailed summaries, heart rate zones, and training load and balance to help you build fitness without burnout.
Widgets, Apple Watch & desktop app
Keep Sonar close with beautiful widgets and an Apple Watch app, and explore your data on the big screen at www.sonarhealth.co
Peer benchmarks
See how you compare to people like you (and the broader community) across key metrics.
Make it yours
Choose the sections, metrics, wallpapers, and views that matter most to you, including a Favorites view for the health data you care about most.
Tailored recommendations
Add your medications, family history, and conditions to receive personalized checkup, vaccine, and screening recommendations based on age, sex, history, and the latest medical guidance.
PUTTING PRIVACY FIRST
Your health data is yours - we do not sell personal data. Our goal is to build an experience our users love, and all product and architecture decisions are built around maximizing user privacy.
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS
Sonar offers a meaningful free experience, empowering you to start transforming your health today with no strings attached. Current-day Recovery, Sleep, Strain, and Nutrition scores are free for all users. It's all part of our mission to accelerate longer, healthier, and happier lives globally.
If you're looking to take your health journey to the next level, you can upgrade to Sonar Pro at any time for access to a suite of powerful features we think you'll love.
Always consult with your doctor prior to making any medical decisions.
Privacy Policy: https://www.sonarhealth.co/legal/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.sonarhealth.co/legal/terms-of-service/

bluejetty:00073454:ios.description:
N12 הראשון בחדשות, עם LIVE ללא הפסקה - מסך צף חדש הנשאר פתוח בכל מצב, צ'אט הכתבים עם עדכונים שוטפים ופרשנויות מנבחרת הכתבים המובילה בישראל.
אפליקציית החדשות N12 מציעה חוויית צריכת חדשות שלא הכרתם. תהיו הראשונים להתעדכן בכל הדיווחים והפרשנויות ותתעדכנו ישירות מנבחרת הכתבים המובילה של חדשות 12.
באפליקציה תתעדכנו בזמן אמת בכל ההתרחשויות בארץ ובעולם; מצב הכלכלה, ביטחון, פוליטיקה, פלילים, צבא, צרכנות, כסף, תרבות, בידור, ספורט, דיגיטל ועוד.
צ'אט הכתבים לכל העדכונים בזמן אמת
נבחרת הכתבים שכולכם מכירים, עובדת בשבילכם 24/7 ומאפשרת לכם גישה מהירה ונוחה לעדכונים בזמן אמת באמצעות מבזקים בצ'אט הכתבים. הרכיב הייחודי מוצע למורידי אפליקציית N12 ומציג צ'אט ובו נבחרת החדשות המובילה בישראל ומיטב כתבי חברת החדשות הידועים והמוכרים מחדשות 12, מעדכנים במשך כל שעות היום בזמן אמת במבזקי חדשות מהארץ ומחו"ל.
צ'אט הכתבים הינו קבוצת ההתכתבות הפנימית של כתבי חדשות 12, שהחלטנו לחשוף גם בפניכם. תהיו הראשונים לקבל דיווחים מהשטח, תמונות וקטעי וידאו בלעדיים.
אתם מחליטים איך לצרוך את החדשות שלכם
אפליקציית N12 מסקרת עבורכם את כל ההתרחשויות והאירועים הבולטים ברחבי העולם ובארץ, במגוון רחב של תחומי עניין; כלכלה, ביטחון, פוליטיקה, צרכנות, כסף, תרבות, בידור, ספורט ועוד. האפליקציה מאפשרת לכם לצרוך את החדשות שהכי מעניינות אתכם באמצעות בחירת התראות וקבלת מבזקים בנושאים חשובים. האפליקציה גם מאפשרת לכם לבחור את גודל הגופן על מנת שתוכלו לראות את החדשות על המסך בצורה טובה ונגישה יותר. תוכלו גם לנווט בסרגל החיפוש בהתאם לנושאים שמעניינים אתכם ולמצוא תכנים ותוכניות שתרצו לקרוא או לצפות בהם.

bluejetty:00041608:ios.name: Photo Cleaner: Daily Delete
bluejetty:00041608:ios.summary:
Open Daily Delete and you see every photo you took on today's date — this year, last year, the year before that. One short deck, already waiting. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep. Tomorrow there's a new one.
That is the whole idea
bluejetty:00041608:ios.description:
Open Daily Delete and you see every photo you took on today's date — this year, last year, the year before that. One short deck, already waiting. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep. Tomorrow there's a new one.
That is the whole idea. Your camera roll didn't fill up in a single day, so you don't clear it in a single day either. You clear today's, and then you get on with your life.
HOW IT WORKS
Every morning there's a fresh deck: the photos you took on this date, across every year you've had a phone. Usually a handful. Sometimes a wedding. Each one fills the screen so you can decide in a second.
Swipe left to delete. Swipe right to keep. A counter tracks the run as you go.
Nothing is actually gone until you say so. Deleted photos land in a review grid first, and you can pull any of them back before you confirm. You are never one wrong swipe away from losing something.
Most people clear their first day in under two minutes.
WHEN YOU WANT TO GO FURTHER
The daily deck is the habit. The month calendar is for when you have time to burn.
Pick any month from any year and swipe the whole thing. The calendar fills in as you go, so you can see exactly which months you've cleared and which ones are still a mess. Some people do a month on a Sunday. Some people do three years in a weekend.
WHAT DAILY DELETE HANDLES FOR YOU
Similar shots, grouped — when you took eight photos of the same thing in twelve seconds, they come up together as one card instead of eight. Pick the keeper, drop the rest, move on.
Screenshots skipped automatically — receipts, memes, and boarding passes never enter your deck. You only triage photos you actually took.
Videos included — the biggest files on your phone are almost always videos you'll never open again.
Your progress, kept — how many photos you've cleared, how many you've kept, and roughly how much space you've won back.
YOUR PHOTOS NEVER LEAVE YOUR PHONE
Daily Delete works entirely on your device. We don't upload your photos to any server. We don't look at them, we can't look at them, and we don't track what you swipe. No ads, no data collection, no third-party trackers.
Other photo cleaners monetise your library. Ours is a simple trade: you pay us, we help you clean up your phone, and that's the entire relationship.
WHY A DAILY HABIT BEATS A BIG CLEANUP
Everyone has tried the marathon session. You sit down with 40,000 photos, you get through 300, you feel worse than when you started, and you never open the app again.
Two minutes a day is a job you'll actually finish. Do today's date every day for a year and you will have looked at your entire library — without ever once sitting down to "deal with your photos."
And you'll like it more than you expect. Most of what surfaces isn't clutter. It's the afternoon you forgot about, four years ago today.
Daily Delete is a subscription. Questions, problems, or feature requests: support@dailydelete.ai

bluejetty:00070355:ios.description:
Jarir Bookstore app brings amazing new benefits to make your shopping experience smoother and more convenient. Browse our extensive catalog, view detailed product information, compare products, read reviews, and purchase your favorite items with ease.
Jarir offers delivery to more than 120 countries around the globe. Whether you're shopping for books, electronics, stationary, Art and Crafts, or gifts, Jarir app ensures a smoother, more rewarding shopping experience in you mobile.
Sleek, User-Friendly Design
Our new UI/UX offers a seamless, modern shopping experience with personalized recommendations.
Seamless Navigation
Browse thousands of books, electronics, and office and school supplies with intuitive categories and smart filters—find what you need in seconds.
Convenient Delivery, Your Way
Choose home delivery, pick up from any showroom with Order & Collect, or enjoy international shipping for selected products to 120+ countries.
Get Notified When It’s Back
Register your interest in out-of-stock products, and we’ll alert you the moment they’re available.
Quick & Secure Checkout
Enjoy fast checkout with multiple payment options, including Mada, credit cards, Apple Pay, Jarir Gift Cards, and installments.
Exclusive for Jarir Discount Card
Unlock discounts, special promotions, and member-only personalized deals.
To provide a rich and personalized experience, Jarir Bookstore App may request access to certain features on your device, such as camera, microphone, notifications, Touch ID, photos, and Bluetooth. These permissions enable features like voice search, product notifications, visual search, customer reviews, and secure authentication.
Jarir Bookstore App supports Arabic and English and offers region-based shopping options for a seamless experience tailored to your location. Not all Items are available for sales and shipping to all countries.
By using this app, you agree to Jarir’s Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy.
If your device supports facial recognition technology, the app may use your camera to enable certain features, such as secure login. Any data processed through this feature remains on your device and is never stored, processed, or shared externally by Jarir Bookstore.

bluejetty:00029579:ios.description:
Is your goal to ACTUALLY SPEAK a new language? Tired of gamified tapping apps that just waste your time? Try Natulang! While other language-learning apps may focus on tapping and typing, Natulang is all about speaking. Our cutting-edge voice generation and recognition capabilities allow you to learn real-life dialogues by speaking them out loud, giving you the confidence you need to speak with native speakers. With Natulang, you'll spend most of your time speaking, which is the key to mastering any language. 
Currently supported languages:
Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese (BR), Dutch, Turkish, Ukrainian, Polish, Czech, English, Japanese
Why Natulang?
•Speak your way to fluency: With Natulang, you'll spend most of your time speaking, which is the key to mastering any language.
•Real-life dialogues: Our cutting-edge voice generation and recognition capabilities make it easy to learn real-life dialogues, giving you the confidence you need to speak with native speakers.
•Personalized learning: Our personalized lessons are tailored to your unique needs, ensuring that the information sticks in your long-term memory.
•Hands-free language learning: With Natulang, you can learn a new language without having to constantly look at your phone or tablet. Our voice generation and recognition capabilities allow for hands-free language learning, so you can practice speaking while cooking, exercising, or doing other activities.
•Accessible for blind users: Natulang fully supports VoiceOver, making it an excellent choice for blind and visually impaired users. The app’s speech-centric approach enables effective, immersive language learning without visual interaction.
•Japanese, step by step: Learn hiragana and kanji with tables, flash cards and kanji explanations, show Japanese with furigana or romaji, and practice reading with short stories built from words you've learned.
PLEASE NOTE:
Some of the lessons in this app are free, but you will need a subscription to access all of them. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current payment period. Your iTunes account will be charged at the same price for renewal within the 24 hours before the end of the current payment period unless you change your subscription preferences in your Account Settings.
You can manage your subscriptions through your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy: http://support.natulang.com/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Service: http://support.natulang.com/eula.html

bluejetty:00095101:android.name: Style My Day: Makeup Tales
bluejetty:00095101:android.summary:
Style My Day: Makeup Tales - Unleash Your Inner Style Guru and Transform Lives!
Step into the captivating world of Style My Day: Makeup Tales, where you're not just a stylist – you're a pivotal part of your clients' journeys. Immerse yours
bluejetty:00095101:android.description:
Style My Day: Makeup Tales - Unleash Your Inner Style Guru and Transform Lives!
Step into the captivating world of Style My Day: Makeup Tales, where you're not just a stylist – you're a pivotal part of your clients' journeys. Immerse yourself in a heartwarming blend of creative expression and engaging narratives as you master the art of makeup, hairstyling, and fashion to help a diverse cast of characters look and, more importantly, feel their absolute best.
Each day in Style My Day: Makeup Tales brings new faces and unique stories. Meet a vibrant array of individuals – from aspiring professionals preparing for crucial interviews and nervous sweethearts heading out on first dates, to radiant brides dreaming of their perfect wedding day and talented artists getting ready for their moment in the spotlight. They all come to you with a vision, a need, and a hope for a transformation that goes beyond mere appearances.
As their trusted style expert, you'll dive deep into their individual needs and desires. Understand their personalities, the significance of their upcoming events, and their personal style preferences. Then, unleash your creative prowess to craft stunning head-to-toe makeovers that not only enhance their beauty but also boost their confidence and empower them to shine.
Become a Master of Transformation:
Masterful Makeup Artistry: Explore an extensive palette of foundations, concealers, eyeshadows, liners, mascaras, blushes, lipsticks, and more. Learn to apply countless techniques, from natural everyday elegance to glamorous red-carpet looks and bold, creative expressions. Discover the power of makeup to highlight features, conceal imperfections, and truly transform a face.
Trendy Hairstyling Expertise: Discover the perfect hairstyles to complement each client's features and the occasion. Cut, color, style, and add intricate details to create everything from sleek and professional looks to flowing romantic waves and edgy modern styles. Experiment with a variety of hair tools and products to achieve stunning results.
Curate Fashion-Forward Outfits: Browse through a diverse wardrobe of stylish clothing, elegant dresses, chic separates, and eye-catching accessories. Develop your fashion sense to select the ideal ensembles that reflect each client's personality and the event they're preparing for. Learn how to coordinate colors, patterns, and silhouettes to create unforgettable looks.
Unravel Engaging Client Stories: Get to know your clients on a personal level. Listen to their stories, understand their challenges, and share in their triumphs. Your styling choices will directly impact their confidence and their ability to face the world with renewed vigor. Experience the satisfaction of knowing your artistry has made a real difference in their lives.
Tackle Exciting Makeover Challenges: Each client presents a unique styling challenge. Interpret their requests, understand the event's requirements, and put your skills to the test to deliver breathtaking results. From subtle enhancements to dramatic transformations, every makeover is an opportunity to showcase your talent and creativity.
Unlock New Styles and Premium Items: As you successfully complete makeovers and build your reputation, you'll unlock new and exciting makeup products, trendy hairstyles, and fashionable clothing items. Expand your styling toolkit and stay ahead of the latest trends to offer your clients the very best.
Express Your Unique Vision: With a vast array of customization options, Style My Day: Makeup Tales empowers you to express your own artistic vision. Experiment with different combinations of makeup, hair, and fashion to create unique and memorable looks that reflect your personal style.
Are you ready to embark on a heartwarming journey of creativity, style, and personal connection? Download Style My Day: Makeup Tales today and start making a real difference, one stunning makeover at a time!
