bluejetty:00073578:ios.name: Tap it 3D: Tap blocks out
bluejetty:00073578:ios.summary:
If you are looking for a fun, relaxing, and addictive 3D puzzle game? Then Tap it 3D: Tap blocks out is a great choice for you
In this 3D block puzzle game, you will tap the blocks in order to clear them out. Keep in mind that the tiles
bluejetty:00073578:ios.description:
If you are looking for a fun, relaxing, and addictive 3D puzzle game? Then Tap it 3D: Tap blocks out is a great choice for you
In this 3D block puzzle game, you will tap the blocks in order to clear them out. Keep in mind that the tiles or blocks will move in only one direction. Also, some tiles will be blocked by other tiles, therefore, you have to choose the tiles carefully to unblock all the cubes. The level will be completed once you tap all blocks out and clear the screen.
As you progress to a higher level, there will be bigger, harder, and more complicated shapes. These levels will be a great challenge and brain teaser. Thus, this Tap it 3D: Tap block out will bring your IQ to a next level.
HOW TO PLAY
This tile puzzle game is very easy to play. All you have to do is tap it and unblock all cubes. Each block will fly away in only one direction, and their direction is indicated on the blocks. Thus, you have to approach this game carefully, so as not to get stuck.
Also, you can swipe your finger to change the viewpoint and angle of the blocks. Moreover, use 2 fingers to zoom in or zoom out, so that you can see the blocks more clearly.
FEATURES
- Relaxing and soothing background music and sound effects, promising to bring your stress away
- Many different block skins, with unique designs
- Including different effects that will please your eyes
What are you waiting for? Tap it 3D: Tap block out is a perfect game to leverage your brain!

With dynamic environments, intense battles, and an array of characters to control, Angry Lion Adventure offers a truly unique and exciting gaming experience for players who love action and exploration!

bluejetty:00080019:ios.description:
Turn text into natural speech — and speech into text. Instantly, privately, everywhere. Even offline.
SayWave is the fastest way to speak and be heard. Type anything and hear it in stunning, natural Apple voices. Or tap the mic and watch your words appear as you talk — transcribed entirely on your device.
TEXT TO SPEECH
• Every Apple voice, every language and accent — including Premium and Enhanced voices
• Follow along as each word is highlighted while it's spoken
• Continuous Reading: one message flows into the next, hands-free
• Reading speed from 0.5x to 3x — you set the pace
• Tap any message to hear it again, anytime
SPEECH TO TEXT
• Unlimited on-device transcription — fast, accurate, and private
• Automatic end-of-speech detection: just stop talking, and your words become text
• Dictate in dozens of languages
READ ANYTHING
• Import PDFs — every page becomes its own tappable message
• Point your camera at any text, or pick a photo — instant text recognition
• Share PDFs from WhatsApp, Mail, or Files straight into SayWave with "Open in SayWave"
YOUR LIBRARY
• Every text is saved in Topics — pin favorites and keep everything organized
• Search your whole Library and jump straight to the right text
• Recent Texts widget for your Home Screen
• The page follows the spoken word, with optional Sentence Pauses
• Polish your text with Apple Intelligence Writing Tools
SHARE AS AUDIO
• Export anything you write as MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, or FLAC
• Files named by date and time — ready to send anywhere
EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• iMessage app: dictate and insert text right in your chats
• Apple Watch: speak from your wrist
• Home Screen quick actions and Siri shortcuts for instant dictation
• Designed for iPhone and iPad
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline — no internet connection required
• No data collection. Ever. Your voice never leaves your device.
BUILT FOR EVERYONE
• Full VoiceOver support, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion, and more
• Localized in 29 languages
• Free Family Sharing included
Works on iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 and later.
Download SayWave and give your words a voice.
Terms of use : https://iapps.app/Terms
Privacy-policy: https://iapps.app/Privacy

bluejetty:00044786:ios.name: Digipare: Zona Azul Parking
bluejetty:00044786:ios.summary:
Pay for Zona Azul street parking in Brazil with Digipare. Buy credits, activate a parking session and keep track of your parking time in supported cities.
Known locally as Zona Azul, Área Azul or Rotativo Digital, these are designated paid
bluejetty:00044786:ios.description:
Pay for Zona Azul street parking in Brazil with Digipare. Buy credits, activate a parking session and keep track of your parking time in supported cities.
Known locally as Zona Azul, Área Azul or Rotativo Digital, these are designated paid street parking areas with rules that vary by city.
PARKING MADE SIMPLER
• Buy credits using the payment methods available in the app.
• Select the city, vehicle license plate and parking rate to activate a session.
• Set reminders for when your parking time is about to end.
• Check your balance and usage history.
• Extend your session from your phone where the parking scheme and local rules allow.
HOW TO USE DIGIPARE
1. Create an account and add your vehicle's license plate.
2. Select your city and check the parking signs.
3. Buy the credits you need and select the appropriate parking rate.
4. Confirm activation and check when your session expires.
WHERE YOU CAN USE IT
Digipare is one of the accredited apps for Rotativo Digital in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, and a payment option for Área Azul in Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul.
In Cuiabá, Mato Grosso, use Digipare to pay for street parking under the Cidade Verde Estacionamento Rotativo Digital system.
Other partner cities are also supported. Check that your city is available in the app before parking. See the list at www.digipare.com.br/Home/Cidades.
BEFORE YOU PARK
Check the city, license plate, rate and activation confirmation. Follow the parking signs, operating hours and maximum stay. Buying credits does not activate a parking session: confirm activation for the correct vehicle. Keep notifications enabled and check the session's validity in the app.
Available in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Parking is available only in supported locations in Brazil.
Download Digipare to make paying for street parking easier.
Support: contato@digipare.com.br
Learn more: www.digipare.com.br

bluejetty:00044420:ios.summary:

Share your trip with your safety circle s
bluejetty:00044420:ios.description:
Stay safe — and make sure someone knows if you’re overdue.
Use offline maps and GPS to follow your route. See where you’ll have cell coverage and check distance, elevation, and your ETA as you go.
Share your trip with your safety circle so they can follow along on a live map. If you’re overdue, they’re alerted automatically.
Named one of the three best map apps for navigating the wilderness by Outside Magazine.
GET FOUND IF YOU’RE OVERDUE
• Automatic alerts: Your safety circle is notified if you’re overdue
• Live map: Your safety circle can follow your trip and see your location history
• Smart guidance: Your safety circle receives advice on when and how to respond if you’re overdue
STAY ON TRACK
• Offline maps: Download maps ahead of time so you can navigate without service
• GPS tracking: Record your route and see where you’ve been
• Cell coverage maps: See where you’re likely to have signal on the trail
SEE TRAIL STATS & ETA
• Trail stats: Track distance, elevation, and ETA in real time, customized for your activity type and speed—hiking, running, skiing, horseback riding, snow travel, mountain biking, and more
• Make better decisions: Know how far you have left and how long it will take
SHARE YOUR TRIP
• Choose who to share with—no app required for them
• Send a live map link so others can follow your progress
CAIRN IS
+ Simple: Set up a trip in under a minute
+ Flexible: Works for hiking, backpacking, trail running, horseback riding, skiing, cycling, climbing, camping, hunting, fishing, boating, and more
+ Customizable: Control how often location is recorded to balance accuracy and battery
FREE TRIAL
Maps, trails, and cell coverage data are always free. Start a 7-day free trial to unlock all safety features.
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribing to Cairn Premium helps support the app and our continued efforts to improve outdoor safety. Subscribers also get full access to features that help you stay safer on the trail.
• Subscriptions automatically renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and will identify the renewal cost.
• Payment is charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase
• Terms: https://www.cairnme.com/terms
• Manage subscriptions: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
Need support?
Email us at adventure@cairnme.com

bluejetty:00034859:ios.description:
Get the latest Montana lottery results within minutes of the draws taking place. This easy-to-use app includes the following lotteries:
- Powerball (including Double Play)
- Mega Millions
- Millionaire for Life
- Lotto America
- Montana Cash
- Montana Big Sky Bonus
Powerball, Mega Millions, Millionaire for Life, Lotto America, Montana Cash and Montana Big Sky Bonus also include a full breakdown displaying the number of winners and amount paid out for each prize level.
The following features are also included:
Ticket Checker
----------------------------
Enter and save your chosen numbers to see if you have won or to see how often they have come up in the past. You can also label your tickets – great if you play multiple lines or if you run a syndicate. The ticket checker also highlights prizes won on each ticket as well as calculating the total for each lottery. Only play lotteries on certain days of the week? Not a problem, you can exclude your checked tickets from draws you do not play.
Customizable Notifications

bluejetty:00019509:ios.description:
Toobz is a challenging, fast-paced game that brings together quick reactions, planning, and a little bit of luck.
Your goal is to create a system of "Toobz" (pipes) beginning at a randomly-placed starting point. Your Toobz network must allow water to flow without any spilling. As you advance through levels, you'll have less and less time to place the pieces before the water starts automatically. You can start the water at any time, allowing you to quickly advance to the next level and earn extra points. If you spill any water, though, your game is over and you'll have to try again.
Toobz features three game modes: "Classic Toobz" in which only one upcoming piece is displayed, "Show Toobz" game in which the next four pieces are displayed, and the new "Puzzle" game that starts you out with a full board. Along with each game mode is a "Big Board" option which increases the size of the playing area by more than 2x!
Multiple color themes are available, including a setting to match your system Dark Mode preference.

bluejetty:00044859:ios.summary:
juli can help you to take control of your condition: all your health data together to manage your depression, bipolar disorder, COPD or something else.
Having a chronic condition like COPD, depression or bipolar disorder means constantly w
bluejetty:00044859:ios.description:
juli can help you to take control of your condition: all your health data together to manage your depression, bipolar disorder, COPD or something else.
Having a chronic condition like COPD, depression or bipolar disorder means constantly worrying about getting into an episode again. There are plenty of triggers for that and often it is not clear, whether it is your sleep, your activity/workout or the weather that drives your wellbeing. Your physician probably told you to keep a journal but monitoring all that is more work that anyone would want to invest. 
Actually there is no need to: your smartphone, your apple watch, your step counter, or any other smartwatch, they all do this work for you. juli combines all this data to give you the relevant health information at your fingertips: from monitoring your activity, heart rate or sleep, adding external data like sunshine, pollen or air pollution. juli will also ask you daily a few quick questions about your condition related wellbeing. Questions like:
(For COPD) Did you have to use your inhaler yesterday or did you wake up due to an episode of shortness of breath?
(For depression) How are you today, how is your energy level 
All this data will allow you to find patterns and identify triggers that influence your COPD or depression. juli is the first start into a new you. 
juli’s functions in detail: 
TRACK YOUR WELLBEING: 
Gather health data collected on your smartphone or smartwatch: sleep, activity, workouts, heart rate, cycle, O2 saturation, period and much more
Get real time weather forecast, pollen and air pollution precisely for where your are
Track your daily situation: COPD episodes, mood, energy, medication intake - quick and easily with one touch
DISCOVER TRIGGERS
Visualize your situation on a daily basis, see trends and discover correlations between your wellbeing and other factors.
Take control of your health situation by identifying triggers for your COPD attacks or discovering what helps when you have a depressive episode.
GET REMINDERS
juli makes it easier to remember to take your medicine or use your inhaler, so you can worry less and live healthier. You can keep track of your medication intake and see what impact it has on your wellbeing as a person with COPD, depression or bipolar.
KEEP A JOURNAL
Have a full medical record at your fingertips and add to it personal notes about what is noteworthy. 
The juli founders suffer from various conditions like bipolar disorder themselves. They know exactly, how it is to be at the mercy of your COPD or depression. But they are electronic wizards and thought how to make use of Apple Health, weather data and more for their purpose. They came up with the idea of a health tracker or journal that minimizes the effort to monitor data related to COPD or depression and has a reminder functionality for medication. More chronic conditions are soon to come as well as recommendations and goal setting.
juli is all about you being the manager of your condition. You will find out how much exercise is good for your COPD, whether sunlight will help your depression or how much sleep is a warning signal for your bipolar disorder. Control is about finding out, what has an impact. With juli all your health data is conveniently kept in one place for you to find out. 
juli integrates with the Apple HealthKit API
Our Terms of Service: https://www.juli.co/terms-of-service

Invoice & Estimate Creator is a powerful, easy-to-use app designed to help you create professional invoices and estimates in just a few taps. Tailored for small business owners, freelancers, and contractors, this app combines efficiency with functionality to take your invoicing experience to the next level.

Managing invoices and estimates can be a tedious process. With Estimate, you can quickly generate, send, and track invoices, making financial management seamless and stress-free. Whether you need to create detailed proposals or invoice your clients accurately, Estimate has got you covered.

Key Features:
* Quick & Easy Invoice Creation
* Craft professional invoices with pre-designed templates.
* Customize your invoices with company logos, colors, and personalized notes.
* Add client details and itemized lists with a few clicks.
* Easily create estimates for potential projects and share them with clients.
* Convert approved estimates into invoices in one step.
* Store and manage all your client details in a centralized location.
* Track client interactions, payment history, and contact details.
* Keep tabs on paid and unpaid invoices.
* Set due dates and receive reminders for outstanding payments.
* Multi-Currency Support
* Offline Access
* Generate and save invoices without requiring an internet connection.
* Export invoices as PDFs for easy sharing via email or other communication channels.

Take the hassle out of invoicing and estimates. Simplify your financial operations and save valuable time with the app designed to make your business thrive. Download Estimate now and experience the future of invoicing!

Contact Us
If you have any questions, feedback, or need assistance, please don't hesitate to contact our support team at hussain@hussainmustafa.com. We're here to help you make the most out of Invoice & Estimate Creator and support your journey to better digestive health.

Privacy Policy: https://hussainmustafa.com/privacy-policy-estimate/
Support: https://hussainmustafa.com/estimate-support/

bluejetty:00100395:ios.description:
Speed Rush Moto is a fresh, fast-paced motorcycle racing experience built on a brand-new idea—crafted for players who crave speed, precision, and pure adrenaline. Race through intense tracks, outsmart rival riders, and push your limits as you chase victory in every high-speed challenge.
Feel the rush as you lean into tight corners, unleash powerful boosts on straight lines, and react instantly to dynamic obstacles. Each race tests your reflexes and rewards your skill with currency you can use to enhance your motorcycle or increase race earnings. Build and tune your bike exactly the way you want—focusing on acceleration, handling, or max speed.
Every level introduces new layouts, environments, and opponents with unique riding behaviors, keeping the action exciting and unpredictable. Whether you're a casual player or a racing enthusiast, Speed Rush Moto delivers fast, satisfying gameplay that feels great on mobile devices.
Designed with a renewed vision and a modern approach to arcade racing, this game brings a fresh twist to the genre—perfect for quick sessions and long playthroughs alike.
Features:
 • High-speed motorcycle racing with smooth, responsive controls
 • Fresh design built around a new gameplay vision
 • Challenging tracks with varied environments and layouts
 • Dynamic opponents with distinctive riding styles
 • Deep upgrade system: enhance your bike’s stats or boost your earnings
 • Satisfying progression that rewards precision and smart tuning
 • Optimized performance for all mobile devices
 • Addictive gameplay ideal for short and long sessions
Get ready to launch into the rush—Speed Rush Moto brings a brand-new racing experience to your device. Can you master the speed and dominate every track?

bluejetty:00075985:ios.summary:
Filmic Legacy is available only to filmmakers who paid for Filmic Pro v6 before the 25th of August, 2022. It will continue to receive bug fixes but will not receive any new features.
Filmic Legacy (previously FiLMiC Pro v6) features cuttin
bluejetty:00075985:ios.description:
Filmic Legacy is available only to filmmakers who paid for Filmic Pro v6 before the 25th of August, 2022. It will continue to receive bug fixes but will not receive any new features.
Filmic Legacy (previously FiLMiC Pro v6) features cutting-edge capabilities and a responsive manual filming experience.
A multi-time iOS Video Camera App of the Year, Filmic Pro has been used in more high profile video projects by award winning directors than any other app:
Unsane & High Flying Bird - Steven Soderbergh
Tangerine - Sean Baker
Lose You to Love Me - Selena Gomez
Stupid Love - Lady Gaga
Detour - Michel Gondry
Snow Steam Iron - Zack Snyder
Filmic Pro provides filmmakers, newscasters, teachers, vloggers, and artists with the capability to shoot in a true LOG gamma curve. LOG V2/V3/V3* allows for greater tonal range and flexibility in post production by expanding dynamic range and setting the iPhone’s capabilities on par with traditional camera systems costing thousands more.
Filmic Pro also offers a range of cinematic film looks that can be applied in-camera at time of capture to deliver a truly cinematic aesthetic without the need for timely grading in post.*
Note: Multicam support is not included in Filmic Pro but is available in our companion app: DoubleTake.
v6 Banner Features:
• Dual arc slider controls for manual focus and exposure
• Live analytics suite of Zebras, False Color and Focus Peaking (limited to 30fps at 4k and 60fps at 1080p)
• Dolby Vision HDR support (limited to 4K 30fps. Incompatible with CineKit)
• ProRes support on 13/14 series
• Realtime film looks (8-bit/DolbyVision)*
• Frame.io Camera to Cloud integration on iPhone 11 & newer
• 10-bit SDR support for 12 series & newer*
• Clean HDMI Out for monitoring & webcam use
• Ramped zoom rocker
• Waveform monitor including tri-mode histogram
• Manual white balance adjustment & custom presets
• Content Management (CMS) for file naming
• FiLMiC Sync account to store presets in the cloud and share between devices
• Gamma curve controls for Natural, Dynamic, Flat and LOGv2/V3/V3+*
• Shadow and highlight controls
• RGB, saturation and vibrance controls
Foundation Features:
• Standard, manual and hybrid shooting modes. A shooting style for any skill level.
• Apple Watch support for remote start/stop + video preview
• Vertical and landscape support
• Variable speed zoom
• Sync audio frame rates of 24, 25, 30, 48, 50 and 60 fps
• High speed frame rates of 60,120, 240 fps (hardware dependent)
• Slow and fast motion FX
• Time lapse capture
• Tri-mode histogram, including waveform
• Downsampling to lower resolutions
• Saved shooting presets
• Framing guide overlays
• Image stabilization
• Support for Filmic Remote. Remote allows you to control an iOS device running Filmic Pro with a second device running Filmic Remote.
Full manual controls with pull capabilities for:
• Exposure: ISO and shutter speed
• Manual focus
• Zoom
8 aspect ratios including:
• Widescreen (16:9)
• Super 35 (2.39:1)
• Ultra Panavision (2.76:1)
• Square (1:1)
Share your video through any iOS share-capable apps like: Facebook, DropBox, FTP.
4 encoding options to balance quality and file size:
• Filmic Extreme (~150Mbps encoding at 4K on latest gen devices)
• Filmic Quality
• Apple Standard
• Economy
3rd Party Hardware Support:
• 1.33x and 1.55x anamorphic desqueeze
• 35mm lens adapters
• Horizontal flip
Supported Gimbals:
• Zhiyun Smooth 4/5
• DJI OSMO Mobile 1/2/3/4/5
Advanced Audio Features:
• Pro audio formats: PCM, AIFF, AAC
• 44.1 & 48kHz
• Headphone monitoring
• Pro audio meter
• Manual input gain
• External microphone level control
*Note: Not all features available on older devices and resolution and frame rate restrictions may apply.*

bluejetty:00023378:ios.name: Merge Life
bluejetty:00023378:ios.summary: In Merge Life, you will decorate your child’s room as they age from baby to adult! Become obsessed with endless interior design projects, but don’t forget about the child's needs, as he’ll start crying and misbehaving. Your goal is to merge
bluejetty:00023378:ios.description:
In Merge Life, you will decorate your child’s room as they age from baby to adult! Become obsessed with endless interior design projects, but don’t forget about the child's needs, as he’ll start crying and misbehaving. Your goal is to merge items to complete “orders” for your child, like a bottle for the hungry baby or a toy. And as you complete orders you’ll get golden stars (for being a good parent!) that you will use to upgrade your babies bedroom and accessories!
Once you’re finished the babies bedroom, baby will grow up, and it’ll be time to make the toddlers room! And then the tweens room, then the teens room, all they way up to their first apartment. Remember, kids look different at different ages, so make sure the room's interior design matches the age, and the child is happy!
There are millions of items to merge and unlock, exploration will lead to game changing discoveries. As you level up through the game, the child has to choose a life path option - astronaut, athlete, or rockstar. Help him in these important decision-making process!
Decorate the Child’s Room: Decorate the child’s room as they age from baby to adult! 
Merge Items to Complete Item Orders: Merge items together to complete your tasks for a specific item that the baby needs. 
Unlock New Items: As you level up through the game and age up the kid, you can unlock new mergeable items.
Merge Life is so much fun. Join and see for yourself today!
Visit https://lionstudios.cc/contact-us/ if have any feedback, need help on beating a level or have any awesome ideas you would like to see in the game!
From the Studio that brought you Mr. Bullet, Happy Glass, Ink Inc and Love Balls!

bluejetty:00036974:ios.description:
Runtopia - The Ultimate Running Tracker That Pays You to Walk, Run, and Live a Healthier Life! 
With Runtopia, every step you take and every mile you run can be converted into Sports Coins, similar to Sweatcoin, Stepcoin, and Lifecoin. These coins can be exchanged for amazing rewards like PayPal cash, gift cards, memberships, and more through our LUCKY WHEEL GAME, just like Growfitter! Whether you're a beginner, marathon enthusiast, or aiming to lose weight and get in shape, Runtopia is the perfect walking and running tracker to help you achieve your goals and earn rewards along the way! 
 Runtopia also offers a variety of features to make your workouts more efficient and keep you motivated:
1. Real-time tracking of running and walking data, including distance, pace, calories, and more 
2. Professional real-time voice guidance to make your training more effective 
3. Personalized training plans based on individual needs, suitable for all fitness levels and weight loss goals 
4. A community of millions of running enthusiasts from around the world, encouraging each other and progressing together 
5. Win PayPal cash, gift cards, and more through the LUCKY WHEEL game, just like walk and earn apps!
6. Fun fitness tasks to help you earn Sports Coins faster 
7. Beautiful medal system, rewarding you for every record broken or achievement unlocked 
 It Pays to Walk and Run with Runtopia Earn Sports Coins by completing walking and running tasks and tracking your step count, then use them to join the LUCKY WHEEL to get rewards you love: memberships, PayPal cash, gift cards, and more. The more you exercise, the faster you'll earn rewards, similar to Sweatcoin and Stepcoin!
 Motivating Reward Mechanism We use Sports Coins to encourage everyone to get moving, just like Lifecoin and Growfitter. Whether you enjoy running or walking, you can earn Sports Coins every day by completing different tasks and accumulating steps. The more you exercise, the more Sports Coins you'll accumulate. bluejetty:00073650:ios.summary:

1Blocker is very easy to use — just flip a couple of switches to s
bluejetty:00073650:ios.description:
1Blocker lets you block obtrusive ads, sneaky trackers, and annoying elements on sites. With 1Blocker, you’re safe online and nothing will distract you from enjoying sites.
1Blocker is very easy to use — just flip a couple of switches to start blocking ads and trackers. The app will automatically receive cloud updates to the built-in filters silently, so you don’t need to do anything. It’s as simple as setting and forgetting.
1Blocker is a fully native app designed to extend Safari naturally. It’s lightweight and doesn’t drain your battery by taking up your device’s resources.
The blocking itself is super fast because Safari does it itself. We only provide filters to Safari and don’t modify webpages in any way. This vastly improves efficiency because Safari knows in advance what should be blocked. So, with 1Blocker, sites load on average 2-5x faster.
It’s important to note that not all ads can be blocked though. Some sites use techniques that make it impossible for us to block their ads using currently available features for Safari content blockers.
SECURE BY DESIGN
1Blocker is secure and private. It doesn’t have access to webpages and doesn’t track you in any way.
We believe that privacy is not for sale. That's why we don't have an "Acceptable Ads" program. We stay independent, and the only way we make money is through direct sales of 1Blocker in the App Store to you.
ADVANCED CUSTOMIZATION
1Blocker is a highly customizable content blocker, providing the possibility to create powerful custom rules. It allows you to create custom rules that block any URL by providing a regular expression or hide any element by CSS. It also lets you block cookies. (Available in Premium)
AVAILABLE ON ALL DEVICES
1Blocker is available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Your preferences and custom rules are always in sync through iCloud no matter which device you're using.
FEATURED IN THE PRESS
1Blocker has been featured in TechCrunch, Lifehacker, MacStories, Macworld, and many more.
FEATURES AVAILABLE FOR FREE
• The ability to enable one category (for example, Block Ads only)
• Whitelisting sites right from the Safari extension
• Whitelist synchronization between devices via iCloud
FRIENDLY SUPPORT
Send your feedback at @1BlockerApp on Twitter or via email. Your feedback is always very welcome and considered for the next release.
We have been making 1Blocker since 2015. We believe it’s the best all-around package currently available in the App Store.
Privacy Policy: https://1blocker.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://1blocker.com/terms

bluejetty:00092493:ios.description:
The myBaptist Health Arkansas mobile application allows for Arkansas' largest and most trusted healthcare provider to be one click away! Our useful app offers appointment scheduling services, provider bios and a health library that's full of educational resources. Baptist Health is constantly striving to improve the health and wellness of the communities we serve. The myBaptist Health Arkansas app is just one of the many ways we're working to keep you and your family healthier and happier.
Easy-to-use features include:
• Search our "locations" section for medical centers, family clinics and specialty clinics to find care that's conveniently close.
• Research our providers' wide range of services and offerings to find care that's right for you.
• Utilize RideShare when you need transportation to and from our hospital or clinic locations.
• Connect your personal health records through MyChart with a private and secure, HIPAA compliant connection. View test results, schedule appointments, message your doctor, request medication refills and more!
• View healthcare information and resources through our online health library.
• Healthcare providers are in the palm of your hand, day or night, with Baptist Health Virtual Care (provides urgent care and pediatric care offerings).
• Stay up-to-date with the latest news and educational offerings by browsing the Baptist Health blog.
With your permission, myBaptist Health Arkansas uses Apple Health features along with MyChart to help you reach your health goals:
• Physical fitness is a vital part of overall health, and myBaptist Health Arkansas assists with your vitals by sharing activity data for active calories burned, blood glucose levels, your respiratory rate, and distance and steps travelled.
• To keep track of your progress, this app can store your height and weight to better record changes in body fat, your metabolic rate, and even body temperature.
• Nutritional information and hydration levels can be recorded and shared with your practitioner.
myBaptist Health Arkansas can share information on a user's vitals as recorded on MyChart including; 
• Heart rate and resting heart rate
• Blood pressure
• Oxygen levels
• VO2 Max, your body's rate of oxygen consumption
• And body temperature
With the user's permission, all data can be streamed from MyChart and collected in the background to support remote patient monitoring for real-time results.
The most trusted name in healthcare is now at your fingertips. Download the myBaptist Health Arkansas mobile application today!

bluejetty:00041551:ios.description:
Welcome to the inner-ring of Warrior Poet Society.
This is where you join Warrior Poet Society and gain access to exclusive shows, take full training classes, interact with the brotherhood through forums, and support the mission of Warrior Poet Society — all inside the WarPoet App.
Get access to all of the great Warrior Poet Society content on your favorite device. We’ve got firearms and self-defense training, home-defense tactics, mindset and preparedness lessons, exclusive shows, and behind-the-scenes content you won’t find anywhere else.
What you get in the WarPoet App
• Unlimited streaming of hundreds of videos and hours of exclusive training and shows, with new content added regularly.
• Serious training made practical – pistol, rifle, concealed carry, home defense, CQB, medical, mindset, and more from trusted instructors.
• Exclusive Warrior Poet shows – long-form conversations, live call-in shows, series, and member-only content available only in the WarPoet App.
• Training. Shows. Freedom. All in one place so you can grow as a protector, husband, father, and leader.
• Watch anywhere – at home or on the go, on your TV, smartphone, or tablet.
• Pick up where you left off – your progress and watch history sync across devices.
• Engage with the brotherhood – interact with other Warrior Poets through community features and forums (where available).
Join the WarPoet App now and move deeper into the Warrior Poet Society mission: to train protectors and defend life, liberty, and truth.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Warrior Poet Society Network on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.

Ever envisioned yourself as the mastermind behind a thrilling amusement park? Now's your chance to step into the shoes of a visionary park manager and transform your dream into a reality. Embark on a captivating journey where you'll design, build, and operate an entertainment empire that will leave visitors spellbound.
In this adrenaline-fueled time-management game, you'll juggle multiple responsibilities, from crafting captivating rides and attractions to ensuring the smooth operation of your park. Are you ready to transform your amusement park dreams into a reality? Embrace the thrill of this captivating time-management game and build a legacy as the undisputed amusement park tycoon.

bluejetty:00082232:ios.description:
Join Margaret, a brilliant young science student, on an extraordinary adventure in "Find Joe: Secret of the Stones." After witnessing a mysterious meteorite crash into her small city, Margaret is drawn into a thrilling quest filled with danger, mystery, and discovery. Uncover the secrets of the powerful stones and unravel a story deeply connected to the "Find Joe: Unsolved Mystery" universe. Whether you're a seasoned fan or new to the Find Joe series, these games can be enjoyed in any sequence, providing a seamless adventure experience.
Game Features:
Multilingual Support: Play in over 10+ languages with English voiceovers, enhancing your immersion into the game’s atmospheric adventure.
 Dynamic Visuals and Audio: Explore a variety of beautifully designed locations with stunning graphics, fluid animations, and immersive sound effects that draw you deeper into the mystery.
 Find Hidden Objects and Clues: Sharpen your detective skills by uncovering hidden objects and vital clues that are key to solving the puzzles and unraveling the mysteries of the powerful stones.
 Escape Dangerous Traps: Navigate through treacherous traps and avoid dangers that challenge your ability to survive and advance in your quest.
 Solve Engaging Puzzles:Test your intellect with an array of puzzles that demand clever thinking and problem-solving skills to progress.
 Interact with Unique Characters: Encounter a range of distinct characters who can either aid or obstruct your journey. Decide whom to trust as you piece together each part of the puzzle.
Exciting Mini Games: Engage in compelling mini-games that are essential to discovering the secrets hidden within the meteorite's powers.
"Find Joe: Secret of the Stones" invites you not just to play a game, but to solve a profound mystery. Can Margaret uncover the secret of the stones and secure her survival in this perilous adventure? Dive into this mystery, where every clue, puzzle, and encounter enriches your experience and brings you closer to the truth. Join now and forge your path through the enigmatic challenges that await.

bluejetty:00062578:ios.description:
Every chord you need, and your songs ready for the stage.
Pocket Guitar Chords is a fast, clear chord reference with everything you need to play your songs live: chord charts, set lists, and a stage view built to be read at arm's length.
CHORDS
• 180 chords: every root with 15 chord types, from major and minor to 7ths, sus, 6/9, augmented and diminished
• More than one shape for most chords, with finger numbers
• Hear every chord: strum it, or play it string by string
• Capo control that shifts the sound to match
• Search by name (try “Bm7”) and keep your favorites one tap away
• “Sounds great with” suggests chords that go together
• Left-handed diagrams
NAME THAT CHORD
Tap where your fingers are on the fretboard and the app tells you what you’re playing, then lets you hear it.
SONGS
• Chart the chords for each song, section by section
• Transpose up or down, set a capo and tempo
• Tap any chord to hear it
• Auto-scroll while you play
SET LISTS
• Put songs in running order for a gig, with the venue and date
• Play the set: big, high-contrast chords on a dark screen that stays awake, with the next song shown at the bottom
• Step through the set song by song
WIDGETS
• Next Gig: your upcoming set list and its songs on your home or lock screen
• Chord of the Day: a new chord every day
ALSO
• Designed for iPhone and iPad
• Light and dark appearance
• No account needed. Your songs and set lists stay on your device.

bluejetty:00038489:ios.description:
The only app that lets you compare and even combine any (really any!) transport mode like train, bus, taxi, ferry, tram, your own or share car & bike, motorcycle or ride share. TripGo makes it super easy to get from A to B on time with any transport mix. Well ok, we don't do hover boards :)
Our award-winning app puts the multi & mixed modal transport future in your hands right now, when other apps are still only dreaming of it.
Personalize your trips by picking your route preferences. Never be late again by syncing TripGo with your agenda and getting exact departure times.
With TripGo you can schedule your ride, check your fare & timetable, bus and train tickets, transportation directions and get live service alerts.
TripGo delivers results in real-time: Up-to-the minute information on predicted departure/arrival times, GPS locations, navigation and service alerts make for accurate trip planning - TripGo keeps you up to date and on time.
We've also partnered with the cool kids at what3words so you can use three word addresses for your trips.
WHAT USERS SAY
"A must have app!"
"I can't thank you enough for this app!"
"You have improved my life, can't rave enough!"
"Should be 6 stars"
"Awesome love it"

+ Real-time information for public transport (live map): tap on stops and stations to see real-time schedules. Click on a route to see positions of the vehicle, live on the map.
+ Door-to-door options for easy comparison on price, time and environmental impact
+ Automatically plans trips between home, work and events in your calendar
+ Today Widget for instant trip results
+ Apple Watch with instant trip results and access to your favourites
+ Public transport timetables
+ Reminders: add a reminder to your trip to get notified when to leave
+ Pricing for public transport, taxis, tolls and car parks

apple-macos:1641658581.name: Calcifon
apple-macos:1641658581.description:
Calcifon is a simple and multiplatform schedule management app that stores and syncs events in cooperation with iOS calendars and Google Calendar.
■Calcifon features
- Simple and Intuitive
Simply slide left or right to switch month on the monthly schedule screen. Select a date and tap again to see a list of events for the day.
- Reschedule with Drag & Drop
Intuitively change the date of an event by drag & drop on the monthly schedule screen and also on the daily schedule screen.
- Colorful Events
Coloring events makes them easier to distinguish and helps you keep track of your schedule.
- Automatic Sync with iOS and Google Calendar
Sync events with iOS calendar and Google calendar, so the events can be synchronized across your Apple devices.
- Monthly & Daily Schedule View (Premium)
In the iPhone app, you can switch from the monthly schedule screen to the monthly & daily schedule screen.
- iPad App (Premium)
The schedule can be viewed on an iPad with a large screen.
- Weekly Schedule & Monthly Schedule View (Premium)
In the Mac app, you can switch from the main screen to the weekly schedule screen or monthly schedule screen.
- Setting a Background Image (Premium)
You can set a photo as the background of the main screen.
- Notification
Calcifon do not notify the notifications set for events. Notifications set to iOS calendar will be issued by the Apple’s calendar application, and notifications set to Google Calendar will be issued by Google with some notification methods, so please configure the notification settings on those applications.
- Calcifon Premium
Calcifon Premium is available with two purchase options: a monthly subscription, or a yearly subscription.
As for the subscription options, Calcifon Premium automatically renews as a paid subscription, unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the date of renewal. The payment will be charged to Apple ID Account at confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can cancel subscription anytime by turning off auto-renewal through your account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the basic service.
We value the opinions of our users. We welcome your feedback.
- Privacy Policy: https://kaurilab.com/calcifon/privacy-policy
- Terms of Use: https://kaurilab.com/calcifon/terms-of-use

Easily order food, groceries and gifts in your city without leaving home.
Want to order food straight to your door? Or get a grocery delivery of your essentials? We save you time, when you don’t have it. 
WHY USE GLOVO?
▶ Over 80 million downloads worldwide.
▶ Order in 23 countries including Spain, Portugal, Romania, Morocco, Italy, Poland, Croatia, Ukraine, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tunisia, Kenya, Uganda, Ivory Coast, Nigeria, Bulgaria, Serbia, Armenia, Bosnia-herzegovina, Montenegro, Moldova & Andorra.
▶ More than 240,000 restaurants, supermarkets and stores available globally.
▶ Deliveries from the biggest chains: McDonald's, Burger King, KFC, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell, Telepizza, Starbucks, Domino’s Pizza, Carrefour, PENNY., Eataly, Flying Tiger, Kiko Milano, Lafarmacia, Auchan, Decathlon, MediaMarkt and many more.
▶ Your favourite food delivery in minutes: Order burgers, pizza, chicken, kebab, pasta, sandwiches, sushi, poké…anything you want.
▶ Pay however you like. We accept PayPal, card payment, cash and even restaurant vouchers.
▶ Track your delivery or takeaway in real time and chat with our support team if need be.
▶ Subscribe to Glovo Prime and get unlimited free deliveries of food, groceries, and shopping. Save on every delivery! Available in selected countries.
▶ Invite your friends and earn money for each one who places an order on the app.
YOUR FAVOURITE FOOD, IN MINUTES!
Fancy a tasty dinner? Has it been a long day? You deserve to have your food delivered to your door! Or are you on your way somewhere? You can order food to take away and grab it on the go.
With Glovo, you can order up to 65 different types of food in your city. Including a burger from the most famous restaurants, to ordering from your favourite sushi place. There are more than 216,000 restaurants available worldwide for delivery or takeaway of your favourite food, in a matter of minutes.
GROCERY DELIVERY WITHOUT LEAVING HOME
Forget something from the supermarket? Got friends over and want to order another round of drinks or snacks? 
Now you can also order your groceries from the supermarket. Choose whatever you want from your favourite supermarket or local store and Glovo will deliver it to you in a few minutes. Food, snacks, drinks, something sweet, a missing ingredient... any groceries you need! 
THE APP TO ORDER ANYTHING
Glovo delivers everything. Find more than 27000 stores on the app, with all kinds of products. All your shopping on one app: surprise gifts, a last-minute purchase or whatever you need.
And if you need to send or pick up something in your city, Glovo can run errands for you. Choose a pick-up and delivery point and a courier will take care of the rest, with delivery in minutes!
NEED HELP? CONTACT US
If you’re looking for help with an order or have any questions about Glovo, please contact our support team via the support section in our app or on our website.
You can also find us on:

fdroid:app.sidecoin.name: Sidecoin
fdroid:app.sidecoin.summary: Your eCash Drivechains Hub — one wallet, endless sidechains.
fdroid:app.sidecoin.description:
✨ Your Gateway to the eCash Drivechain Universe ✨
Sidecoin puts a whole ecosystem of sidechains in your pocket. One wallet, one seed, and a growing community of networks built on Bitcoin's security.
⚡ WHAT YOU CAN DO
• 🛡️ Track and manage 10 live sidechains, with more on the way
• 💸 Send and receive with on-device signing and a clear review step
• 📷 Scan any QR code to pay in seconds
• 🌍 Explore the Drivechain web with the built-in browser
• 🔐 Unlock with biometrics — just one prompt per session
🚧 DEPOSIT & WITHDRAW — IN DEVELOPMENT
Moving value between L1 and a sidechain is shown in the app for review, but the deposit and withdrawal flows are not live yet — the buttons are clearly marked as under development. Per-platform action workflows are also not wired yet and carry the same under-development marking.
🌐 THE SIDECHAINS
• ⚡ Thunder Network — fast, low-fee everyday payments
• 🌨️ Snowside — full EVM smart contracts, secured by Bitcoin
• 🕵️ zSide — private, shielded transactions
• 🏷️ BitNames — human-readable names and identity
• 💎 BitAssets — tokens, NFTs, and digital assets
• ⚛️ Photon — quantum-resistant cryptography
• 🎯 Truthcoin — decentralized prediction markets
• 🔄 CoinShift — trustless cross-chain swaps
• 🧬 RISCy — RISC-V innovation
• 🏦 FreeBank — Bitcoin-native banking
• ➕ Elements Plus — announced, coming soon (no BIP-300 slot assigned yet)
🧪 TEST NETWORKS
Before the eCash fork activates, Sidecoin runs against the public signet and betanet test networks — the same app, the same wallet, free test coins. L1 reads and broadcasts go to community Esplora endpoints (esplora.signet.drivechain.info, esplora.beta.ecash.ninja); the market price card reads eCash Farm.
🪶 LIGHTWEIGHT BY DESIGN
• No full chain download — talks to public Esplora nodes
• No accounts, no sign-up, no custodian
• The F-Droid build includes every platform and feature free of charge — no paid tier, no locked features
🌱 Powered by BIP-300 Hashrate Escrows and BIP-301 Blind Merged Mining — trustless sidechains secured by Bitcoin's full SHA-256d hashrate.
MIT licensed. Free software.
🚫 No tracking 🚫 No ads 🚫 No data collection
